a: Uleman deamar helach patur, ammay itzterich kera lemaote karka mishshevua? ha kol karka helach hu.
Amar lach: itzterich kera hecha dechafar bah borot shichin umearot.
I name, hecha ditano kelim vekarkaot, vehoda bakkelim vechafar bakkarkaot.
Ta shema, detane rame bar chama: arbaa shomrin tzerichin kefira bemiktzat vehodaa bemiktzat. shomer chinnam, vehashshoel, nose sachar, vehassocher.
Hechi dame? lav daamar leh: helach!

La, daamar leh: shalosh parot masarti lach umetu kullehu bifshia. veamar leh ihu: chada – la hayu devarim meolam, vachada – meta beones, vachada – meta bifshia divena shallome lach. delav "helach" hu.

Ta shema, detane avu derabbi aftoriki lidrabbi chiyyay kammayyta: mane li beyadcha, vehalla omer: en lecha beyadi kelum, vehaedim meidim oto sheyyesh beyado chamishshim zuz, yachol yishshava al hashshear –
Talmud lomar: "al kol aveda asher yomar ki hu ze". al hodaat piv atta mechayyeyvo, vei atta mechayyeyvo al haadaat edim!
Matnita ka ramet aleh derabbi chiyyay?! rabbi chiyyay tanna hu ufaleg.
Veha kera kaamar! hahu lemode miktzat hattaana.
Vaavu derabbi aftoriki amar lach, ketiv "hu" uchetiv "ze", chad lemode miktzat hattaana, vechad lehaadaat edim defatur.
Veiddach: chad lemode miktzat hattaana, vechad lemode mimmin hattaana.
Veiddach mode mimmin hattaana let leh, vesavar leh kerabban gamliel, ditnan: teano chittin, vehoda lo bisorin, patur. verabban gamliel mechayyev.

Hahu raaya dehavu masri leh kol yoma chevata besahade. yoma chad mesaru leh bela sahade. lesof amar lehu: lo hayu devarim meolam. ato sahade ashidu beh daachal tarte minnayyhu. amar rabbi zera: im ita lidrabbi chiyyay kammayyta, mishteva ashsheara.
Amar leh abbaye: im ita mishteva?! veha gazlan hu! amar leh: shekkenegdo kaamena.
Hasheta name deleta lidrabbi chiyyay, nechayyeyveh midderav nachman.
Ditnan: mane li beyadcha, en lecha beyadi – patur. veamar rav nachman: mashbiin oto shevuat hesset.
Derav nachman takkanta hi,
b: Vetakkanta letakkanta la avdinan.
Vetippok leh dehave leh roe! veamar rav yehuda: setam roe pasul.
La kashya: ha dideh, ha dealma. dei la tema hachi, anan chevata leroa hechi masrinan? veha ketiv: "lifne ivver lo titten michshol"! ella chazaka: en adam chote velo lo.
Ze yishshava sheen lo bah pachot mechetzyah [vechulei]. al deit leh mishteva, o al delet leh mishteva! amar rav huna, deamar: shevua sheyyesh li bah veen li bah pachot mechetzyah.
Venema shevua shekkullah shelli. umi yahavinan leh kulla?
Venema shevua shechetzyah shelli – mara leh ledibbureh.
Hasheta name mara leh ledibbureh. deamar: kullah shelli, uledivrechem – shevua sheyyesh li bah veen li bah pachot mechetzyah.

Vechi meachar shezze tafus veomed veze tafus veomed, shevua zo lamma? amar rabbi yochanan: shevua zo takkanat chachamim hi, shello yehe kol echad veechad holech vetokef betallito shel chavero veomer: "shelli hu".
Venema miggo dachashid ammamona chashid name ashshevuata?
La amrinan miggo dachashid ammamona chashid ashshevuata. dei la tema hachi, hay deamar rachamana mode miktzat hattaana yishshava, nema miggo dachashid ammamona chashid ashshevuata.
Hatam ishtemote ka mishtemit leh, kidrabba.
Tidda deamar rav idi bar avin amar rav chisda: hakkofer bemilve – kasher leedut. befikkadon – pasul leedut.
Ella ha detane rame bar chama: arbaa shomrin tzerichin kefira bemiktzat vehodaa bemiktzat – shomer chinnam vehashshoel, nose sachar vehassocher, nema miggo dachashid ammamona chashid ashshevuata!
Hatam name ishtemote ka mishtemit. savar: mashkachna legannav vetafesna leh. i name mashkachna leh baagam umayytena leh.
I hachi, hakkofer befikkadon ammay pasul leedut? nema: ishtemote ka mishtemit, savar ad devacheshna umeshakkachna leh!
Ki amrinan hakkofer befikkadon pasul leedut, kegon deatu sahade veashidu beh dehahi shata iteh lefikkadon beveteh vahava yada, i name dahava naket leh bideh.
Ella ha deamar rav huna, mashbiin oto shevua sheenah birshuto, nema miggo dachashid ammamona chashid ashshevuata!
Hatam name, more veamar: deme ka yahevna leh.
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: veha ka avar al lav delo tachmod"?
"Lo tachmod" leinashe bela deme mashma lehu.

a: Veella ha deamar rav nachman mashbiin oto shevuat hesset, nema miggo dachashid ammamona chashid ashshevuata.
Vetu ha detane rabbi chiyyay: shenehem nishbain venotlin mibbaal habbayit, nema miggo dachashid ammamona chashid ashshevuata.
Vetu ha deamar rav sheshet, shalosh shavuot mashbiin oto: shevua shello pashati bah, shevua shello shalachti bah yad, shevua sheenah birshuti. nema: miggo dachashid ammamona chashid ashshevuata.
Ella la amrinan miggo dachashid ammamona chashid ashshevuata.
Abbaye amar: chayyshinan shemma milve yeshana yesh lo alav.
I hachi nishkol bela shevua!
Ella chayyshinan shemma sefek milve yeshana yesh lo alav.
Velav amrinan tafes mamona missefeka? mishteva name missafek!
Amar rav sheshet bereh derav idi: parshi inashe missefek shevua vela parshi missefek mamona. may tama? mamon iteh bachazara, shevua leteh bachazara.
Bae rabbi zera: tekafah echad befanenu, mahu?
Hechi dame? i deshatek, odoye odi leh. vei deka tzavavch, may hava leh lemebad?
La tzericha dishtek meikkara vahadar tzavavch, may? middeishtik – odoye odi leh, o dilma: kevan deka tzavavch hasheta iggallay milleta dehay dishtek meikkara, savar: ha ka chazu leh rabbanan.

Amar rav nachman, ta shema: bamme devarim amurim sheshshenehem adukin bah, aval hayta tallit yotzet mittachat yado shel echad mehen, hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. hechi dame? i nema kidkatane, peshita! ella shettekafah echad befanenu.

La, hacha bemay askinan – kegon deatu lekamman keditfisu la tarvayyhu, veamrinan lehu: zilu pelugu, unefaku, vahadar ato ki tafes la chad minnayyhu, hay amar: odoye odi li. vehay amar: bidme ogarti nihaleh, deamrinan leh: ad hasheta chashdat leh begazlan, vehasheta mograt leh bela sahadi.

Veibbaet ema, kidkatane: deatu lekamman ki tafes la chad minnayyhu, veiddach mesarech bah saroche, vaafillu lesomchos deamar mamon hammuttal besafek cholkin belo shevua, mode somchos desircha lav kelum hi.
Im timtze lomar tekafah echad befanenu motziin otah miyyado, hikdisha – enah mekuddeshet. im timtze lomar tekafah echad befanenu en motziin otah miyyado, hikdishah belo tekafah – mahu?
Kevan deamar mar: amirato laggavoah kimsirato lahedyot dame. keman detakfa dame.
O dilma: hasheta miha ha la takfa, uchetiv: "veish ki yakdish et beto kodesh vegomer", ma beto birshuto – af kol birshuto, leappoke hay delo birshuto.
Ta shema: dehahi
b: Massuta dahavo minnetzu ala be tere, hay amar didi hu vehay amar didi hu. kam chad minnayyhu akdesha. parshi minna rav chananya verav oshaya vechullehu rabbanan. vaamar leh rav oshaya lerabba: ki azlat kammeh derav chisda lechafri, bei minneh.
Ki ata lesura, amar leh rav hamenuna: matnitin hi. sefek bechorot, echad bechor adam veechad bechor behema, ben tehorim ben temeim: hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. vetane ala: asurim begiza uvaavoda.
Veha hacha deamar tekafo kohen – en motziin oto miyyado, dekatane hammotzi mechavero alav haraya, vechi lo tekafo – asurin begizza uvaavoda.
Amar leh rabba: kedushshat bechor kaamrat – leolam ema lach tekafo kohen motziin oto miyyado, vaafillu hachi asurim begizza uvaavoda, dikdushsha habbaa meeleha shane.
Amar leh rav chananya lerabba, tanya dimsayyay lach: hassefekot nichnasin laddir lehitasser.
Vei salka datach tekafo kohen en motziin oto miyyado, ammay nichnasin laddir? nimtza ze poter mamono bemamono shel kohen!

Amar leh abbaye: i mishshum ha la tesayyeyeh lemar, hacha bemay askinan – kegon delet leh ella tisha, vehu dema nafshach: i bar chiyyuva hu, shappir ka meassar. i lav bar chiyyuva hu, tisha lav bar assore ninhu.
Hadar amar abbaye: lav milleta hi deamri disfeka lav bar assore hi, ditnan: kafatz echad min hammenuyin letochan – kullan peturin.
Vei salka datach sefeka bae assore, leasser mimma nafshach: dei bar chiyyuva hu – shappir meassar, vei lav bar chiyyuva hu – nippetar beminyan harauy.
Deamar rava: minyan harauy poter.

a: Ella may it lach lememar, asiri vadday amar rachamana velo asiri safek. hacha name: asiri vadday amar rachamana velo asiri safek.
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: may sefekot? illema sefek bechorot, "yihye kodesh" amar rachamana, velo shekkevar kadosh.

Ella sefek pidyon peter chamor, vechidrav nachman. deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: yisrael sheyyesh lo asara sefek pitre chamor betoch beto – mafrish alehen asara seyin, umeasseran, vehen shello.

May have ala demassuta? ta shema, deamar rabbi chiyyay bar avin: hava ovada be rav chisda verav chisda be rav huna, ufashta meha deamar rav nachman: kol mamon sheen yachol lehotzio bedayyaynin, hikdisho – eno kadosh.

Ha yachol lehotzio bedayyaynin, hikdisho – kadosh, af al gav dela appekeh. vehaamar rabbi yochanan: gazal velo nityayashu habbealim – shenehem enam yecholin lehakedisho. ze – lefi sheenah shello, veze – lefi sheenah birshuto.
Mi savrat bemassuta mittaltelin askinan? bemassuta mekarkee askinan, dechi yachol lehotzia bedayyaynin, birshuteh kayyma.

Tane rav tachlifa bar mareva kammeh derabbi avahu: shenayim adukim betallit – ze notel ad makom sheyyado maggaat, veze notel ad makom sheyyado maggaat, vehashshear cholkin beshave. machve leh rabbi avahu: uvishvua.
Ella matnitin, dekatane defalgi bahadade, vela katane ze notel ad mekom sheyyado maggaat, hechi mashkachat la? amar rav pappa: ditfisi becharkeshata.
Amar rav mesharsheya, shema minna: hay sudara, kevan detafes beh shalosh al shalosh, karenan beh "venatan lereehu".
Dichman difsik deme, vekane.
Umay shena midderav chisda, deamar rav chisda: get beyadah umeshicha beyado, im yachol lenatteko velahavio etzlo – enah megoreshet, veim lav – megoreshet!
Hatam keritut baenan, velekka. hacha netina baenan, veha ikka.
Amar rava: im hayta tallit muzehevet – cholkin. peshita? la tzericha, dekae dahava be mitze.
Ha name peshita! la tzericha demikrav legabbe dechad. mahu detema daamar leh: pelog hachi, ka mashma lan daamar leh: may chazet defalgat hachi? pelog hachi.
Tanu rabbanan: shenayim adukin bishtar, malve omer: shelli hu, venafal mimmenni umetzativ, velove amar: shellecha hu, uferativ lach – yitkayyem hashshetar bechotmav, divre rabbi.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: yachloku.
Nafal leyad dayyayn – lo yotzio olamit. rabbi yose omer: hare hu bechezkato.
Amar mar: yitkayyem hashshetar bechotmav. vegave leh malve kulleh. velet leh matnitin? shenayim ochazin kulei!
Amar rava amar rav nachman: bimkuyyam – divre hakkol yachloku, ki peligi besheeno mekuyyam.
Rabbi savar: mode bishtar shekketavo – tzarich lekayyeymo. vei mekayyem leh paleg, vei la mekayyem leh la paleg.
May tama? chaspa bealma hu, man ka meshavve leh lehay shetara – love, ha kaamar difria.
Verabbi shimon ben gamliel savar: mode bishtar shekketavo en tzarich lekayyeymo, veaf al gav dela mekayyem leh – yachloku.
Nafal leyad dayyayn lo yotzio olamit,
b: May shena leyad dayyayn? amar rava, hachi kaamar: veacher shemmatza shetar shennafal leyad dayyayn, vehechi dame – dichtav beh henpek, lo yotzio olamit.
Vela mibbaya la ketav beh henpek, deikka lememar katav lilvot velo lava, ella afillu ketav beh henpek, dimkuyyam – lo yachazir, dechayyshinan leferaon.
Verabbi yose omer: hare hu bechezkato vela chayyshinan leferaon. vela chayesh rabbi yose leferaon?
Vehatanya: matza shetar ketubba bashshuk, bizman shehabbaal mode – yachazir laishsha, en habbaal mode – lo yachazir lo laze velo laze.
Rabbi yose omer: odah tachat baalah – yachazir laishsha. nitarmela o nitgarsha – lo yachazir lo laze velo laze.
Efoch: nafal leyad dayyayn lo yotzio olamit, divre rabbi yose. vachachamim omrim: hare hu bechezkato.
I hachi kashya derabbanan adderabbanan!

Shetar ketubba, kullah rabbi yose, vechassore mechassera vehachi katane: en habbaal mode – lo yachazir lo laze velo laze. bamme devarim amurim – shennitarmela o shennitgarsha, aval odah tachat baalah – yachazir laishsha, sherabbi yose omer: odah tachat baalah – yachazir laishsha, nitarmela o shennitgarsha – lo yachazir lo laze velo laze.
Rav pappa amar: leolam la tefoch, rabbi yose ledivrehem derabbanan kaamar lehu.
Ledidi afillu nitarmela o nitgarsha name la chayyshinan leferaon. ledidchu odo li mihat beodah tachat baalah, deyachazir laishsha, delav bat peraon hi.
Vaamaru leh rabbanan: emor tzerare atpesa.
Ravina amar: leolam efoch kammayyta. vetama derabbanan hacha, mishshum dechayyshinan lishte chetubbot. verabbi yose lishte chetubbot la chayesh.

Amar rabbi elazar: machaloket besheshshenehem adukim battofes, ushenehem battoref. aval echad aduk battofes veechad aduk battoref – ze notel tofes, veze notel toref. verabbi yochanan amar: leolam cholkin.
Vaafillu echad aduk battofes veechad battoref. vehatanya: ze notel ad makom sheyyado maggaat! la tzericha dekae toref be mitze.
I hachi may lememra? la tzericha dimkarav legabbe dechad. mahu detema: amar leh pelog hachi, ka mashma lan deamar leh: may chazet defalgat hachi? pelog hachi.
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: lerabbi elazar deamar ze notel tofes veze notel toref, lema leh? vechi latzur al pi tzelochito hu tzarich?
Amar leh: lidme.
Deamar hachi: shetara deit beh zeman, kamma shave? udelet beh zeman, kamma shave? bishtara deit beh zeman – gave mimmeshabede. veiddach – la gave mimmeshabede. yahev leh heach devene bene.
"Veyachloku" name daamaran ledame. dei la tema hachi, shenayim ochazin betallit hachi name defalgi? ha afsedu! ha la kashya,

a: Dechazya liktannim.
Veha deamar rava: im hayta tallit muzehevet – cholkin, hachi name defalgi la, ha afseduha! ha la kashya, dechazya livne melachim.
Veha ditnan: hayu shenayim rochvin al gabbe behema vechulei, hachi name defalgi la? ha afseduha! bishlama tehora – chazya levasar. ella temea, ha afseduha! ella lidme, hacha name lidme.
Amar rame bar chama: zot omeret, hammagbiah metzia lachavero – kana chavero.

Dei salka datach lo kana chavero, tease zo kemi shemmunnachat al gabbe karka, vezo kemi shemmunnachat al gabbe karka, velo yikne lo ze velo ze. ella lav shema minna: hammagbiah metzia lachavero – kana chavero.
Amar rava, leolam ema lach: hammagbiah metzia lachavero – lo kana chavero. vehacha hayeynu tama: miggo dezache lenafsheh zache name lechavreh.
Tidda sheillu amar lishlucho: "tze ugenov li", veganav – patur. veshuttafin shegganvu – chayyayvin. may tama? lav mishshum deamrinan: miggo dezache lenafsheh zache name lechavreh. shema minna.
Amar rava, hasheta deamrat amrinan miggo: cheresh ufikkeach shehigbihu metzia, mittoch shekkana cheresh – kana pikkeach.
Bishlama cheresh kana – deka magba leh ben daat. ella pikkeach bemay kana?
Ella ema: cheresh – kana, pikkeach – la kana. umay miggo? miggo dishne chershin bealma kanu, hay name kane.
Hay may? im timtza lomar hammagbiah metzia lachavero kana chavero, hane mille hecha deka magba leh addata dechavreh. hay addata dideh ka magba leh, ihu la kane – leacharine makne?!
Ella ema: mittoch shello kana pikkeach – lo kana cheresh.
Vechi tema, may shena mishshene chershin dealma – hatam takkinu lehu rabbanan dela ate leinnetzoye. hacha memar amar: pikkeach la kane, ana ekne?

Amar leh rav acha bereh derav adda lerav ashe: diyyukeh derame bar chama mehecha? i nema meresha "shenayim ochazin betallit", hatam hay kaamar "kullah shelli vaana aggebahta kulla", vehay amar "kullah shelli vaana aggebahta kulla".
Ella meha dekatane "ze omer kullah shelli veze omer kullah shelli" ha tu lema li? ella mimmishna yetera shema minna: hammagbiah metzia lachavero – kana chavero.
Veha okemna resha bimtzia, vesefa bemikkach umimkar!
Ella missefa: "ze omer kullah shelli veze omer chetzyah shelli", ha tu lema li? ella mimmishna yetera shema minna: hammagbiah metzia lachavero – kana chavero.
Umimmay devimtzia? dilma bemikkach umimkar?

Vechi tema: i bemikkach umimkar may lememra? itzterich, salka datach amena hay dekaamar "chetzyah shelli" leheve kemeshiv aveda velippetar. kamashma lan dehay iarome ka maarim. savar: i amena "kullah shelli", baena ishtevoe, ema hachi, deehve kemeshiv aveda veippetar!
Ella meha, hayu shenayim rochvin al gabbe behema, ha tu lema li? ella mimmishna yetera shema minna: hammagbiah metzia lachavero – kana chavero.
Vedilma, ha kamashma lan derochev name kane!
Ella missefa: bizman shehen modin o sheyyesh lahen edim – cholkin belo shevua. bemay? i bemikkach umimkar, tzericha lememar?! ella lav bimtzia, ushema minna hammagbiah metzia lachavero kana chavero.
Verava amar lach: miggo dezache lenafsheh zache name lechavreh.
Hayu shenayim rochvin. amar rav yosef, amar li rav yehuda:
b: Shemait minneh demar shemuel tarte: rachuv umanhig, chad kane vechad la kane. vela yadana he minnayyhu.
Hechi dame? illema rachuv lechodeh umanhig lechodeh – manhig lechodeh mi ikka man deamar la kane? ella i ikka lememar dela kane – rachuv hu deikka lememar.
Ella rachuv bimkom manhig ibbaya leh. may: rachuv adif – deha tafes ba, o dilma manhig adif – deazla mechamateh?
Amar rav yosef, amar li rav yehuda: nechze anan, ditnan: hammanhig sofeg et haarbaim, vehayyoshev bakkaron sofeg et haarbaim. rabbi meir poter et hayyoshev bakkaron.
Umiddeafech shemuel vetane: vachachamim potrin et hayyoshev bakkaron, shema minna rachuv lechodeh la kane, vechol shekken rachuv bimkom manhig.
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: ha zimnin saggiin amart lan: nechze anan, vela amart lan mishshemeh derav yehuda.
Amar leh: ivra! udechirna name daamari leh: hechi pashet mar rachuv miyyoshev? yoshev la tafes bemosera, rachuv tafes bemosera! vaamar li rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: mosera la kane.
Ikka deamri, amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: hechi pashet mar rachuv miyyoshev? yoshev la tafes bemosera, rachuv tafes bemosera! amar leh, hachi tena idde: mosera la kane.
Ittemar name, amar rabbi chelbo amar rav huna: mosera mechavero – kana. bimtzia uvenichse hagger – la kane.
May leshon mosera? amar rava: idi asbera li keadam hammoser davar lachavero. bishlama mechavero kane, deka masar leh chavreh. ella bimtzia uvenichse hagger man ka masar leh delikne?
Metivi: hayu shenayim rochvin al gabbe behema vechulei. manni? ilema rabbi meir – hasheta yoshev kane, rachuv mibbee?! ella lav rabbanan, ushema minna rachuv kane.
Hacha bemay askinan – bemanhig beraglav. i hachi, hayeynu manhig! tere gavvne manhig, mahu detema: rachuv adif, deha manhig vetafes ba, ka mashma lan.
Ta shema: shenayim shehayu moshchin begamal, umanhigin bachamor, o shehaya echad moshech veechad manhig,

a: Bemidda zot kanu. rabbi yehuda omer: leolam lo kana ad shettehe meshicha begamal vehanehaga bachamor.
Katane mihat: o shehaya echad moshech veechad manhig, moshech umanhig – in. aval rachuv la!
Hu haddin daafillu rachuv, veha dekatane moshech umanhig – leappoke midderabbi yehuda deamar: ad shettehe meshicha begamal vehanehaga bachamor, kamashma lan daafillu ippecha name kane.
I hachi, liarvinhu velitninhu: shenayim shehayu moshchin umanhigin ben begamal ben bachamor!
Ikka chad tzad dela kane: ikka deamri meshicha bachamor, veikka deamri hanehaga begamal.
Veit demotev missefa: bemidda zo kana. "bemidda zo" lemaote may? lav lemaote rachuv?! la, lemaote ippecha.
I hachi, hayeynu rabbi yehuda! ikka benayyhu tzad echad delo kana: it deamri meshicha bachamor, veikka deamri hanehaga begamal.
Ta shema: echad rachuv chamor veechad tafus bemosera – ze kana chamor, veze kana mosera. shema minna: rachuv kane!
Hacha name bemanhig beraglav. i hachi, nikne name rachuv bemosera! ema: ze kana chamor vachatzi mosera, veze kana chatzi mosera.
Bishlama rachuv kane, dekamagba leh ben daat. ella tafus bemosera bemay kane?
Ema: ze kana chamor vechulleh mosera, veze kana ma shettafus beyado.
Hay may?! im timtze lomar hammagbiah metzia lachavero kana chavero – hane mille hecha deka magba leh addata dechavreh. hay addata dideh ka magba leh: ihu la kane, leacharine makne?!
Amar rav ashe: ze kana chamor uvet paggeha, veze kana ma shettafus beyado – vehashshear lo kana, lo ze velo ze.
Rabbi avahu amar: leolam kidkatane – hoil veyachol lenattekah velahaviah etzlo.

Veha derabbi avahu beruta hi, dei la tema hachi: tallit shehi munnachat chetzyah al gabbe karka vechetzyah al gabbe ammud, uva echad vehigbiah chetzyah meal gabbe karka uva acher vehigbiah chetzyah meal gabbe ammud, hachi name dekamma kane uvatra la kane, hoil veyachol lenatteka[] velahavia[] etzlo?! ella ha derabbi avahu beruta hi.
Ta shema, rabbi eliezer omer: rachuv bassade umanhig bair – kana! hacha name manhig beraglav. i hachi, hayeynu manhig! tere gavvne manhig.
I hachi, rachuv bair may tama la kane? amar rav kahana: lefi sheen darkan shel bene adam lirkov bair.

Amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana: ella meatta, higbiah arnaki beshabbat, sheen darkan shel bene adam lehagebiah arnaki beshabbat, hachi name dela kane? ella may daavad – avad, vekane, hacha name may daavad – avad, ukeni.
Ella bemikkach umimkar askinan, daamar leh: kene kederech shebbene adam konin.
b: Vei reshut harabbim hu – kane, vei adam chashuv hu – kane, vei ishsha hi – kanya, vei inish zila hu – kane.
Bae rabbi elazar: haomer lachavero "meshoch behema zo liknot kelim shealeha", mahu?
Liknot: mi amar leh kene! ella: "meshoch behema zo ukene kelim shealeha", mahu? mi mahneya meshicha divhema leaknoye kelim, o la?
Amar rava: i amar leh kene behema ukene kelim – mi kane kelim? chatzer mehallechet hi, vechatzer mehallechet lo kana.
Vechi tema kesheamda, veha kol sheillu mehallech lo kana – omed veyoshev lo kana!
Vehilcheta bichfutah.

Amaru leh rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerava: ella meatta, haya mehallech bisfina, vekaftzu dagim venaflu letoch hassefina, hachi name dechatzer mehallechet hi vela kane?! amar leh: sefina menach nayycha, umayya hu deka mamtu la.

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: ella meatta hayta mehallechet birshut harabbim vezarak lah get letoch chekah o letoch kaltah, hacha name dela miggarsha?! amar leh: kaltah menach nayycha, veihi deka mesaggeya mittuta.

Mishna haya rochev al gabbe behema veraa et hammetzia veamar lachavero "tenah li". netalah veamar: "ani zachiti bah" – zacha bah. im mishshennetanah lo, amar: "ani zachiti bah techilla" – lo amar kelum.
Gemara tenan hatam: mi shellikket et happea, veamar: "hare zo lifloni ani", rabbi eliezer omer: zacha lo. vachachamim omrim: yittenenna leani hannimtza rishon.
Amar ulla amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: machloket meashir leani,

Derabbi eliezer savar: miggo dei bae mafkar nichseh vehave ani vachaze leh – hasheta name chaze leh. umiggo dezache lenafsheh, zache name lechavreh. verabbanan savri chad miggo amrinan, tere miggo la amrinan.
Aval meani leani, divre hakkol zacha lo – demiggo dezache lenafsheh zache name lechavreh.

Amar leh rav nachman leulla: velema mar, meani leani machloket, deha metzia hakkol aniyyim etzlah, utenan: haya rochev al gabbe behema veraa et hammetzia veamar lachavero "tenah li", netalah veamar "ani zachiti bah" – zacha bah.
I amrat bishlama: meani leani machloket,

a: Matnitin manni – rabbanan hi. ella i amrat beashir veani machloket, aval meani leani divre hakkol zacha lo, ha manni? la rabbanan vela rabbi eliezer!
Amar leh, matnitin deamar techilla.

Hachi name mistabbera, dekatane sefa: im mishshennetanah lo amar ani zachiti bah techilla – lo amar kelum. techilla besefa lema li? peshita, af al gav dela amar techilla, techilla kaamar. ella lav ha ka mashma lan, resha deamar "techilla".
Veiddach: tena sefa legalloye resha. sefa, deamar techilla. resha, dela amar techilla.
Rav nachman verav chisda deamri tarvayyhu: hammagbiah metzia lachavero – lo kana chavero.
May tama – have tofes levaal chov bimkom shechav laacherim, vehattofes levaal chov bimkom shechav laacherim – lo kana.
Etiveh rava lerav nachman: metziat poel leatzmo.
Bamme devarim amurim – bizman sheamar lo baal habbayit "nakkesh immi hayyom", "ador immi hayyom". aval amar lo "ase immi melacha hayyom" – metziato shel baal habbayit hu!
Amar leh: shane poel, deyado keyad baal habbayit hu.
Vehaamar rav: poel yachol lachazor bo afillu bachatzi hayyom!
Amar leh: kol kamma dela hadar beh, keyad baal habbayit hu. ki hadar beh, tama acharina hu, dichtiv: "ki li vene yisrael avadim, avaday hem" – velo avadim laavadim.
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: hammagbiah metzia lachavero – kana chavero. veim tomar mishnatenu, deamar "tenah li", vela amar "zechah li".
Mishna raa et hammetzia venafal aleha, uva acher vehechzik bah – ze shehechzik bah zacha bah.

Gemara amar resh lakish mishshum abba kohen bardela: arba ammot shel adam konot lo bechol makom. [may tama] takkinu rabbanan, dela (ate) [leto] leinnetzoye. amar abbaye: motev rabbi chiyyay bar yosef pea. amar rava: motev rabbi yaakov bar idi nezikin.
Amar abbaye, motev rabbi chiyyay bar yosef pea: natal miktzat pea vezarak al hashshear – en lo bah kelum. nafal lo aleha, peras tallito aleha – maavirin oto hemenna. vechen beomer shichcha.
Vei amrat arba ammot shel adam konot lo bechol makom, nikno leh arba ammot dideh!
Hacha bemay askinan – dela amar "ekne".
Vei takkun rabbanan, ki la amar may have?!
Kevan dinfal, galli dateh devinfila nicha leh denikne, bearba ammot la nicha leh denikne.
b: Rav pappa amar: ki takkinu le rabbanan arba ammot – bealma, besade devaal habbayit la takkinu le rabbanan. veaf al gav dizcha leh rachamana begavva, ki zecha leh rachamana – lehalloche ba ulenakkote pea, lemihve chatzero la zecha leh rachamana.

Amar rava, motev rabbi yaakov bar idi nezikin: raa et hammetzia venafal lo aleha uva acher vehechzik bah, ze shehechzik bah zacha ba. vei amrat arba ammot shel adam konot lo bechol makom – nikno leh arba ammot dideh!
Hacha bemay askinan, dela amar "ekne". vei takkun rabbanan, ki la amar may have! kevan denafal aleha, galli dateh devinfila nicha leh denikne, bearba ammot la nicha leh denikne.
Rav sheshet amar: ki takkinu rabbanan, besimta dela dachaki rabbim. birshut harabbim deka dachaki rabbim, la takkinu rabbanan.
Veha bechol makom kaamar!
Kol makom – leetoye tzidde reshut harabbim.
Veamar resh lakish mishshum abba kohen bardela: ketanna en lah chatzer, veen lah arba ammot. verabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yannay amar: yesh lah chatzer, veyesh lah arba ammot.

Bemay kamippalgi? mar savar chatzer mishshum yadah itrabbay, ki hechi deit la yad – chatzer name it la. umar savar chatzer mishshum shelichut itrabbay, vechi hechi dishlichut let la – chatzer name let la.
Mi ikka man deamar chatzer mishshum shelichut itrabbay? vehatanya: "beyado" – en li ella yado. gaggo, chatzero vekarpefo minnayin – talmud lomar: "himmatze timmatze", mikkol makom.
Vei salka datach chatzer mishshum shelichut itrabbay, im ken matzinu shaliach lidvar avera, vekayyma lan en shaliach lidvar avera!
Amar ravina: hecha amrinan deen shaliach lidvar avera – hecha deshaliach bar chiyyuva hu, aval bechatzer delav bar chiyyuva hu – michayyayv sholcho.
Ella meatta, haomer leishsha veeved: "tzeu ginvu li" – delav bene chiyyuva ninhu, hachi name demichayyayv sholchan?!
Amrat ishsha veeved – bene chiyyuva ninhu, vehasheta miha let lehu leshallome. ditnan: nitgarsha haishsha, nishtachrer haeved – chayyayvin leshallem.
Rav samma amar: hecha amrinan en shaliach lidvar avera – hecha dei bae aved vei bae la aved, aval chatzer dival kurcheh motev ba, michayyayv sholcho.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu kohen deamar leh leyisrael: tze vekaddesh li ishsha gerusha, i name ish deamar la leishsha: akkifi li katan.

Lehach lishshana deamar kol hecha dei bae aved i bae la aved – la michayyayv sholcho. hane name i bae aved, i bae la aved – la michayyayv sholchan. lehach lishshana deamrat kol hecha deshaliach lav bar chiyyuva michayyayv sholcho, hane name kevan delav bene chiyyuva ninhu – michayyayv shulechan.
Umi ikka leman deamar chatzer lav mishshum yadah itrabbay? vehatanya: "yadah", en li ella yadah. gaggah, chatzerah vekarpefah minnayin? talmud lomar: "venatan" mikkol makom!
Leinyan get kulle alma la peligi dechatzer mishshum yadah itrabbay, ki peligi leinyan metzia. mar savar:

a: Yalfinan metzia migget, umar savar: la yalfinan metzia migget.
Veibbaet ema: biktanna kulle alma la peligi deyalfinan metzia migget. vehacha bekatan ka mippalgi,
Mar savar: yalfinan katan mikketanna. umar savar: la yalfinan katan mikketanna.
Veibbaet ema: mar amar chada, umar amar chada vela peligi.

Mishna raa otan ratzin achar metzia, achar tzevi shavur, achar gozalot shello perchu, veamar: "zachta li sadi" – zachta lo. haya tzevi ratz kedarko, o shehayu gozalot mafrichin, veamar: "zachta li sadi" – lo amar kelum.
Gemara amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: vehu sheomed betzad sadehu.
Vetikne leh sadehu, deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: chatzero shel adam kona lo shello middato!
Hane mille bechatzer hammishtammeret, aval chatzer sheenah mishtammeret, i omed betzad sadehu – in, i la – la.
Umena temra dechatzer sheenah mishtammeret, i omed betzad sadehu – in, i la – la?

Detanya: haya omed bair veomer, "yodea ani sheomer sheyyesh li bassade poalim shechechuhu – lo yehe shichcha", yachol lo yehe shichcha – talmud lomar: "veshachachta omer bassade", "bassade veshachachta" – velo bair.
Ha gufa kashya: amrat yachol lo yehe shichcha – alma have shichcha, venasev la talmuda "bassade veshachachta" velo bair, alma la have shichcha!
Ella lav hachi kaamar: bassade – shachuach meikkaro have shichcha, zachur ulevassof shachuach en shichcha, may tama – dechevan dekae gabba, havya lay chatzero vezachta leh.
Aval bair, afillu zachur ulevassof shachuach – havya shichcha. may tama – deleteh gabbeh delizke leh.
Mimmay? dilma gezerat hakkatuv hi, devassade neheve shichcha uvair la neheve shichcha!
Amar kera: "lo tashuv lekachto", lerabbot shichchat hair.
Hay mibbee leh lelav!
Im ken nema kera "lo tikkachennu", may "lo tashuv" – lerabbot shichchat hair.
Veakkatti mibbee leh, lichditnan: shellefanav – en shichcha, shelleacharav – yesh shichcha, shehu beval tashuv.
Ze hakkelal: kol shehu beval tashuv – shichcha, kol sheeno beval tashuv – eno shichcha!
Amar rav ashe, amar kera "yihye" – lerabbot shichchat hair.
Vechen amar ulla: vehu sheomed betzad sadehu. vechen amar rabba bar bar chana: vehu sheomed betzad sadehu.
Etiveh rabbi abba leulla: maase berabban gamliel uzekenim shehayu baim bisfina. amar rabban gamliel: issur sheani atid lamod natun lihoshua,
b: Umekomo musekar lo. veissur acher sheani atid lamod, natun laakiva ben yosef, kede sheyyizke bo laaniyyim, umekomo musekar lo.
Vechi rabbi yehoshua verabbi akiva betzad sadehu shel rabban gamliel hayu omdin?
Amar leh: dame hay merabbanan kidla gamri inashe shemata.
Ki ata lesura amar lehu: hachi amar ulla vehachi otviteh. amar leh hahu merabbanan: rabban gamliel mittaltele aggav mekarkee hikna lahem. rabbi zera kabbela, rabbi abba la kabbela.

Amar rava: shappir avayd dela kabbela, vechi lo haya lahem sudar liknot mimmennu bachalifin? ella tovat hanaa enah mamon liknot mimmennu bachalifin. hacha name tovat hanaa enah mamon liknot al gabbe karka.
Vela hi, mattenot kehunna netina ketiva behu. chalifin, derech mikkach umimkar hu. mittaltelin aggav mikkarka, netina allimta hi.
Rav pappa amar: daat acheret makna otan shane.

Umena temra – ditnan: raa otan ratzin achar hammetzia kulei, veamar rabbi yirmeya amar rabbi yochanan: vehu sheratz acharehen umaggian. uvae rabbi yirmeya, bemattana heach? kabbela minneh rabbi abba bar kahana af al pi sheratz acharehen veen maggian. may tama – lav mishshum dedaat acheret makna otan shane?!
Amar leh rav shimi lerav pappa: hare get, dedaat acheret – makna otah, veamar ulla: vehu sheomedet betzad betah o betzad chatzerah. shane get deiteh beal korchah.
Matkef la rav sheshet bereh derav idi: velav kal vachomer hu – uma get deiteh beal korchah, i omedet betzad betah uvetzad chatzerah – in, i la – la. mattana demiddateh lo kol shekken!
Ella amar rav ashe:

a: Chatzer itrabbay mishshum yad vela gara mishshelichut. gabbe get dechov hu lah: en chavin leadam ella befanav. gabbe mattana dizchut hu lo: zachin leadam shello befanav.

Gufa. raa otan ratzin achar hammetzia vechulei. amar rabbi yirmeya amar rabbi yochanan: vehu sheratz acharehen umaggian. bae rabbi yirmeya: bemattana heach? kabbela minneh rabbi abba bar kahana: af al pi sheratz acharehen veen maggian.
Bae rava: zarak arnaki befetach ze veyatza befetach acher, mahu? avir sheen sofo lanuach kemunnach dame, o la?

Amar leh rav pappa lerava, veamri la rav adda bar matna lerava, veamri la ravina lerava: lav hayeynu matnitin. raa otan ratzin achar hammetzia, veamar rabbi yirmeya amar rabbi yochanan: vehu sheratz acharehen umaggian, uvae rabbi yirmeya: bemattana heach? vekabbela minneh rabbi abba bar kahana: bemattana af al pi sheratz acharehen veen maggian.
Amar leh, mitgalgel kaamrat? shane mitgalgel dichmunnach dame.

Mishna metziat beno uvitto hakketannim, metziat avdo veshifchato hakkenaanim, metziat ishto – hare ellu shello. metziat beno uvitto haggedolim, metziat avdo veshifchato haivrim, metziat ishto sheggershah, af al pi shello natan ketubba – hare ellu shellahen.
Gemara amar shemuel: mippene ma amru metziat katan leaviv – shebbeshaa shemmotzah meritzah etzel aviv, veeno meacher beyado.

Lememra desavar shemuel katan let leh zechiyyay lenafsheh middeorayyta? vehatanya: hassocher et happoel – yelakket beno acharav. lemechetza, lishlish velirvia – lo yelakket beno acharav. rabbi yosi omer: ben kach uven kach yelakket beno veishto acharav. veamar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yose.

I amrat bishlama katan it leh zechiyyay lenafsheh, ki ka melakket – lenafsheh ka melakket, vaavu minneh ka zache. ella i amrat katan let leh zechiyyay lenafsheh, ki ka melakket – leaviv ka melakket, avu ashir hu, ammay ishto uveno melakket acharav?
Shemuel, tama detanna didan kaamar, veleh la sevira leh.
Vesavar rabbi yose katan it leh zechiyyay middeorayyta? vehatnan: metziat cheresh, shote vekatan yesh bahen mishshum gazel mippene darche shalom. rabbi yose omer: gazel gamur.
Veamar rav chisda: gazel gamur middivrehen. nafka minna lehotziah bedayyaynin.
Ella amar abbaye: asauha kemi shehalchu bah namoshot. daaniyyim gufayyhu massechi datayyhu. savri: bereh dehaych melakketoy leh.
Amar leh rav adda bar matna leabbaye: vechi muttar laadam leharebitz ari betoch sadehu kede sheyyiru aniyyim veyivrechu?
Ella amar rava:
b: Asu sheeno zoche kezoche, may tama – aniyyim gufayyhu nicha lehu, ki hechi dechi agru ledidhu nilkot benayyhu batrayyhu.

Ufeliga derabbi chiyyay bar abba. deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: lo gadol – gadol mammash, velo katan – katan mammash, ella gadol vesamuch al shulchan aviv – zehu katan. katan veeno samuch al shulchan aviv – zehu gadol.
Metziat avdo veshifchato haivrim hare hu shel atzman. ammay lo yehe ella poel? vetanya: metziat poel leatzmo. bamme devarim amurim – bizman sheamar lo: "nakkesh immi hayyom", "ador ammi hayyom".
Aval amar lo "ase immi melacha hayyom" – metziato levaal habbayit.
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: hacha beeved nokev margaliyyot askinan, sheen rabbo rotze leshannoto limlacha acheret.
Rava amar: bemagbiah metzia im melachto askinan.
Rav pappa amar: kegon shessecharo lelakket metziot. vehechi dame? deakkefay agma bichvore.
Hay shifcha hechi dame? i deayytay shete searot, may baaya gabbeh?
Vei dela ayytay shete searot, i iteh leav – daavu havya! vei deleteh laav – tippok bemitat haav.
Deamar resh lakish: ama haivriyya kona atzmah bemitat haav mershut haadon mikkal vachomer. velav ittotav resh lakish?
Nema mehay name tehve teyuveta!
La, leolam deiteh leav, umay "hare hen shellahen" – leappoke derabba.
Metziat ishto. gershah peshita!
Hacha bemay askinan? bimgoreshet veenah megoreshet, deamar rabbi zera amar shemuel: kol makom sheamru chachamim "megoreshet veenah megoreshet" – balah chayyayv bimzonoteha.
Tama may amur rabbanan metziat ishsha levalah, ki hechi dela tehve la eva. hacha it la eva veeva.
Mishna matza shitre chov, im yesh bahen achrayut nechasim – lo yachzir, shebbet din nifrain mehen. en bahen achrayut nechasim – yachzir, sheen bet din nifrain mehen, divre rabbi meir.
Vachachamim omrim: ben kach uven kach lo yachzir, mippene shebbet din nifrain mehen.

Gemara bemay askinan? ilema keshechayyayv mode, ki yesh bahen achrayut nechasim ammay lo yachzir? ha mode! vei kesheen chayyayv mode, ki en bahen achrayut nechasim ammay yachzir? nehi dela gave mimmeshabede – mibbene chare migba gave!
Leolam keshechayyayv mode, vehacha hayeynu tama: dechayyshinan shemma katav lilvot benisan velo lava ad tishri, veate lemitraf lakochot shello kaddin.
I hachi, kol shetare deatu lekamman nechush lehu hachi!
Kol shetare la rie, hane rie.
Ella ha ditnan: kotvin shetar lallove af al pi sheen malve immo. lechattechilla hechi katvinan? nechush shemma katav lilvot benisan velo lava ad tishri, veate lemitraf lakochot shello kaddin!
Amar rav assi:

a: Bishtare hakenaa, deha shabed nafsheh.

I hachi, matnitin dekatane: "im yesh bahen achrayut nechasim lo yachazir", veokemna keshechayyayv mode, umishshum shemma katav lilvot benisan velo lava ad tishre, veate lemitraf lakochot shello kaddin, ammay lo yachazir?
Nechze i bishtar hakenaa – ha shabed leh nafsheh! i bishtar dela hakenaa – lekka lemechash, deha amrat ki lekka malve bahadeh la katvinan.
Amar lecha rav assi: af al gav dishtare delav hakenaa, ki lekka malve bahadeh la katvinan, matnitin kevan dinfal ittera leh, vechayyshinan dilma ikkeri uchetuv.
Abbaye amar: edav bachatumav zachin lo, vaafillu shetare delav hakenaa.
Mishshum dekashya leh: kevan deamrat bishtare delav hakenaa ki leteh lemalve bahadeh la katvinan, lekka lemechash deikkeri uchetuv.

Ella ha ditnan: matza gitte nashim veshichrure avadim, deyayteke, mattana veshovarim – hare ze lo yachzir, shemma ketuvim hayu venimlach alehem shello littenam. vechi nimlach alehem may have? veha amrat: edav bachatumav zachin lo?
Hane mille hecha deka matu lideh. aval hecha dela matu lideh la amrinan.
Ella matnitin dekatane: matza shitre chov, im yesh bahem achrayut nechasim – lo yachzir. veokimna keshechayyayv mode, umishshum shemma katav lilvot benisan velo lava ad tishre.
Bishlama lerav assi deamar bishtare akneyayta – moke la bishtare delav akneyayta, vechidamrinan. ella leabbaye, deamar: edav bachatumav zachin lo, may ikka lememar?
Amar lach abbaye, matnitin hayeynu tama: dechayyshi[ynan] leferaon veliknuneya.

Velishmuel, deamar la chayyshinan leferaon veliknuneya, may ikka lememar? hanicha i savar la kerav assi deamar bishtare hakenaa – moke matnitin bishtare delav hakenaa. ella i savar keabbaye deamar edav bachatumav zachin lo, may ikka lememar?
Shemuel moke lematnitin kesheen chayyayv mode.
I hachi, ki en bahen achrayut nechasim ammay yachzir? nehi dela gave min meshabede, mibbene chare migbe gave!
Shemuel letameh: deamar shemuel, omer haya rabbi meir: shetar chov sheen bo achrayut nechasim – en gove la mimmeshabedi vela mibbene chare.
Vechi meachar sheeno gove ammay yachzir? amar rabbi natan bar oshaya: latzor al pi tzelochito shel malve.
Venahdereh (lehu) lelove latzor al pi tzelochito shel love! love hu
b: Deamar lo hayu devarim meolam.

Amar rabbi elazar: machloket besheen chayyayv mode. derabbi meir savar: shetar sheen bo achrayut nechasim – eno gove la mimmeshabedi vela mibbene chare. verabbanan savri: mimmeshabedi hu dela gave, mibbene chare – migba gave. aval keshechayyayv mode – divre hakkol yachzir, vela chayyshinan leferaon veliknuneya.

Verabbi yochanan amar: machloket keshechayyayv mode, derabbi meir savar: shetar sheen bo achrayut nechasim – mimmeshabedi hu dela gave, aval mibbene chare – migba gave. verabbanan savri: mimmeshabede name gave. aval kesheen chayyayv mode – divre hakkol lo yachzir, dechayyshinan leferaon.
Tanya kevoteh derabbi yochanan, uteyuveta derabbi elazar bachada, uteyuveta dishmuel betarte.

Matza shitre chov veyesh bahem achrayut nechasim, af al pi sheshshenehem modim – lo yachzir lo laze velo laze. en bahen achrayut nechasim, bizman shehallove mode – yachzir lammalve, en hallove mode – lo yachzir lo laze velo laze, divre rabbi meir.

Shehaya rabbi meir omer: shetaroy sheyyesh (bahem) [bo] achrayut nechasim, gove minnechasim meshuebadim. vesheen (bahem) [bo] achrayut nechasim, gove minnechasim bene chorin. vachachamim omrim: echad ze veechad ze gove minnechasim meshuebadim.

Teyuveta derabbi elazar bachada, deamar: lerabbi meir shetar sheen bo achrayut nechasim – eno gove minnechasim meshuebadim velo minnechasim bene chorin. vekaamar: ben lerabbi meir ben lerabbanan la chayyshinan liknuneya.

Uvarayyta katane: shetar sheen bo achrayut nechasim – mimmeshabedi hu dela gave, ha mibbene chorin migba gave. vekatane: ben lerabbi meir ben lerabbanan, chayyshinan liknuneya. dekatane: af al pi sheshshenehem modim lo yachzir lo laze velo laze. alma chayyshinan liknuneya.
Veha hane tarte hu?

a: Chada hu, dechad taam hu, demishshum dekaamar rabbi elazar machloket besheen chayyayv mode – hu metaretz hachi.
Teyuveta dishmuel betarte: chada kerabbi elazar, deha moke matnitin besheen chayyayv mode.
Vachada deamar shemuel: matza shetar hakenaa bashshuk – yachzir labbealim, vela chayyshinan leferaon.
Teyuveta dekatane hacha: af al pi sheshshenehem modim lo yachzir lo laze velo laze, alma chayyshinan leferaon, vechol shekken hacha dela mode love – dechayyshinan leferaon.
Amar shemuel: may tamayyhu derabbanan? savri achrayut taut sofer hu.
Amar leh rava bar ittay lerav idi bar avin: umi amar shemuel hachi? vehaamar shemuel: shevach, shefer veshibud – tzarich limmalech!
Lema man deamar ha la amar ha?
La kashya: kan bishtar halevaa, dela yahev inash zuze bichdi. kan bemikkach umimkar, deaved inash dezaven ara leyomeh.

Ki hahi daavu bar ihi zevayn illita meachateh, ata baal chov tarfa minneh. ata lekammeh demar shemuel, amar leh: ketava lach achrayut? amar leh: la. amar leh: im ken, zil lishlama. amar leh: veha mar hu deamar achrayut taut sofer hu! amar leh: hane mille bishtare halevaa, aval bishtare mikkach umimkar – la, daavid inash dezaven ara leyomeh.

Amar abbaye: reuven shemmachar sade leshimon beachrayut, uva baal chov diruven veka taref leh minneh, dina hu deazel reuven umishtae dina bahadeh, vela matze amar leh: lav baal devarim didi at, deamar leh: demappekat minneh, alay didi hadar.
Ikka deamri: afillu shello beachrayut name, deamar leh: la nicha li delehve leshimon taromet alay.
Veamar abbaye: reuven shemmachar sade leshimon shello beachrayut, veyatzu aleha asikin, ad shello hechzik bah
b: Yachol lachazor bo, mishshehechzik bah – eno yachol lachazor bo. deamar leh: chayyta dekitre sevart vekabbelt. meematay havya chazaka? mikki dayesh ammitzre.
Veikka deamri, afillu beachrayut name, deamar leh: achvi tirfach vaashallem lach.
Ittemar: hammocher sade lachavero venimtzet sheenah shello. rav amar: yesh lo maot veyesh lo shevach. ushemuel amar: maot yesh lo, shevach en lo.

Beo minneh merav huna: peresh lo et hashshevach mahu? tama dishmuel mishshum dela payresh shevacha, vehacha ha payresh le, o dilma tameh dishmuel: kevan delet leh karka, michaze keribbit. amar lehu: in velav, verafya bideh.
Ittemar, amar rav nachman amar shemuel: maot yesh lo, shevach en lo, af al pi shepperash lo et hashshevach. may tama? kevan dekarka en lo, sechar meotav omed venotel.
Etiveh rava lerav nachman: en motziin laachilat perot, velishvach karkaot, velimzon haishsha vehabbanot minnechasim meshuebadim, mippene tikkun haolam.
Mimmeshabedi hu dela mappekinan, ha mibbene (chorin) – [chare] mappekinan, vekatane miha lishvach karkaot, may lav belokeach miggazlan!
La bevaal chov.
I bevaal chov, ema resha: en motziin laachilat perot, vei bevaal chov, baal chov mi it leh pere? vehaamar shemuel: baal chov gove et hashshevach. shevach – in, aval perot – la!
Ella peshita begozel venigzal. umidderesha begozel venigzal, sefa name begozel venigzal.
Midde irya?! ha kidita veha kidita.

Veha la tane hachi: leshevach karkaot ketzad? hare sheggazal sade mechavero vahare hi yotza mittachat yado, keshehu gove – gove et hakkeren minnechasim meshuebadim, veshevach – gove minnechasim bene chorin.
Hechi dame? illema kidkatane, gazlan mimman gave? ella lav: kegon sheggazal sade mechavero umecharah leacher vehishbichah!
Amar lach: lav tarotze ka metartzat? taretz name bevaal chov.
Ta shema: laachilat perot ketzad? hare sheggazal sade mechavero vahare hi yotza mittachat yado, keshehu gove – gove et hakkeren minnechasim meshuebadim, uferot gove minnechasim bene chorin.
Hechi dame? illema kidkatane, gazlan mimman gave? ella lav: kegon sheggazal sade mechavero umecharah leacher vehishbichah!

Amar rava: hacha bemay askinan – kegon sheggazal sade mechavero, melea perot, veachal et happerot, vechafar bah borot, shichin umearot. ba nigzal ligbot keren – gove minnechasim meshuebadim, ba nigzal ligbot perot – gove minnechasim bene chorin.
Rabba bar rav huna amar: kegon

a: Shennetaluha massikin, ba nigzal ligbot keren – gove minnechasim meshuebadim, ba nigzal ligbot perot – gove minnechasim bene chorin.
Rava la amar kerabba bar rav huna: "hare hi yotza mittachat yado" – bedina mashma. verabba bar rav huna la amar kerava: "hare hi yotza mittachat yado" – beena mashma.

Rav ashe amar: litzdadin katane, kegon sheggazal sade mechavero melea perot veachal et happerot umachar et hassade, ba lokeach ligbot keren – gove minnechasim meshuebadim. ba nigzal ligbot perot – gove minnechasim bene chorin.
Ben lerava ben lerabba bar rav huna, milva al pe hu, umilva al pe eno gove minnechasim meshuebadim!
Hacha bemay askinan – kesheamad baddin vahadar zabben.
I hachi, perot name! kesheamad baddin al hakkeren, velo amad baddin al happerot. umay paska? setama demilleta ki tava inish – karna tava beresha.
Vesavar shemuel lokeach miggazlan let leh shevacha?
Veha amar leh shemuel lerav chinnana bar shilat: immelech, uchetov "shufera shevacha ufere".
Bemay? i bevaal chov – mi it leh pere? vehaamar shemuel: baal chov gove et hashshevach, shevach – in, aval perot – la. ella lav, belokeach miggazlan!
Amar rav yosef: hacha bemay askinan – kegon sheyyesh lo karka.
Amar leh abbaye: vechi muttar lilvot sea bisa bimkom sheyyesh lo karka?
Amar leh, hatam halevaa, hacha zevine.
Ikka deamri, amar rav yosef: hacha bemay askinan – kegon shekkanu miyyado.
Amar leh abbaye: vechi muttar lilvot sea bisa bimkom shekkanu miyyado?
Amar leh: hatam halevaa, vehacha zevine.

Gufa, amar shemuel: baal chov gove et hashshevach. amar rava: teda, shekkach kotev lo mocher lallokeach: "ana ekum vaashappe vaadakke vaamarek zevine illen, innun veamlehon ushevachehon, veekum kodamach, utzevi zavoyna denan vekabbel alohi".
Amar leh rav chiyyay bar avin lerava: ella meatta mattana dela katev leh hachi, hachi name dela taref shevacha?! amar leh: in.
Vechi yafe koach mattana mimmecher? amar leh: in yafe veyafe.

Amar rav nachman: ha matnita mesayyay leh lemar shemuel, vehuna chavrin mokem la bemille acharine. detanya: hammocher sade lachavero, vahare hi yotza mittachat yado, keshehu gove – gove et hakkeren minnechasim meshuebadim, veshevach gove minnechasim bene chorin.
Vehuna chavrin mokem la bemille acharine, belokeach miggazlan.

Tanya iddach: hammocher sade lachavero vehishbichah, uva baal chov uterafah, keshehu gove, im hashshevach yoter al hayyetzia – notel et hashshevach mibbaal hakkarka, vehayyetzia mibbaal chov. veim hayyetzia yetera al hashshevach – en lo ella hotzaa shiur shevach mibbaal chov.

Veha shemuel bemay mokem la? i belokeach miggazlan – kashya resha, deamar shemuel: lokeach miggazlan let leh shevacha. i bevaal chov – kashya resha vesefa, deamar shemuel: baal chov gove et hashshevach!
Ibbaet ema belokeach miggazlan, kegon sheyyesh lo karka. i name beshekkanu miyyado.
Ibbaet ema bevaal chov. vela kashya: kan beshevach
b: Hammaggia lakketefayim, kan beshevach sheeno maggia lakketefayim.
Veha maasim bechol yom, veka magbe shemuel afillu beshevach hammaggia lichtefayim!
La kashya: ha demassek beh keshiur ara ushevacha. ha dela massek beh ella keshiur ara, deyahev leh shevacheh umesallek leh.

Hanicha leman deamar: i it leh zuze lelokeach la matze mesallek leh levaal chov, shappir. ella leman deamar ki it leh zuze lelokeach matze mesallek leh levaal chov, nema leh: illu hava li zuze, hava mesallekinnach mikkulla ara, hasheta delet li zuze, hav li geriva deara (beara) [beha ara] shiur shevachay!
Hacha bemay askinan – kegon sheasao appoteke. daamar leh: lo yehe lecha peraon ella mizzo.
Hikkir bah sheenah shello ulekachah, amar rav: maot yesh lo, shevach en lo. ushemuel amar: afillu maot en lo.
Bemay kamippalgi? rav savar: adam yodea shekkarka en lo, vegamar venatan leshum pikkadon. venema leh leshum pikkadon! savar la mekabbel.
Ushemuel savar: adam yodea shekkarka en lo, vegamar venatan leshum mattana. venema leh leshum mattana! kesifa leh milleta.

Veha peligi bay chada zimna, deittemar: hamekaddesh et achoto, rav amar: maot chozrin, ushemuel amar: maot mattana. rav amar: maot chozrin, adam yodea sheen kiddushin tofsin baachoto, vegamar venatan leshum pikkadon. venema la leshum pikkadon! savar la mekabbela minneh.
Ushemuel amar: maot mattana – adam yodea sheen kiddushin tofsin baachoto, vegamar venatan leshum mattana. venema lah leshum mattana! kesifa la milleta
Tzericha: dei ittemar beha, beha kaamar rav, dela avdi inashe deyahavi mattanot lenucheraa. aval gabbe achoto ema mode leh lishmuel.
Vei ittemar behach, behach kaamar shemuel: aval beha ema mode leh lerav, tzericha.
Ben lerav deamar pikkadon, ben lishmuel deamar mattana, hay leara bemay ka nachet, uferot hechi achel?
Savar: ana echot leara veebed veechol begavvay ki hechi dahava ka aved ihu, lechi ate mareh deara zuzay nehvo, lerav deamar pikkadon – pikkadon, lishmuel deamar mattana – mattana.
Amar rava, hilcheta: yesh lo maot veyesh lo shevach, veaf al pi shello peresh lo et hashshevach. hikkir bah sheenah shello ulekachah – maot yesh lo, shevach en lo.
Achrayut taut sofer hu, ben bishtare halevaa, ben bishtare mikkach umimkar.
Bea minneh shemuel merav: chazar ulekachah mibbealim harishonim, mahu? amar leh: ma machar lo rishon lashsheni – kol zechut shettavo leyado.
May tama? mar zutera amar: nicha leh dela nikreyeh gazlana. rav ashe amar: nicha leh deleku behemanuteh.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu demit lokeach: man deamar nicha leh dela likreyeh gazlana –

a: Ha mit leh. uman deamar: nicha leh delekum behemanuteh – bahade bene name nicha leh delekum behemanuteh.
Sof sof karu leh bene lokeach "gazlana"!

Ella: ikka benayyhu demit gazlan. man deamar nicha leh leinish dela likreyuhv "gazlan", ha mit leh. leman deamar nicha leh delekum behemanuteh, hachi name af al gav demit – nicha leh delekum behemanuteh!
Sof sof karu livneh: "bene gazlana".

Ella ikka benayyhu deyahava bemattana. man deamar nicha leh delekum behemanuteh – mattana name nicha leh delekum behemanuteh. man deamar nicha leh dela nikreyuhv "gazlana" – amar leh: may gezali minnach.
Peshita: zabbena, orta, veyahava bemattana – lav leokoma kamme lokeach ka bae.
Nefala leh birusha, yerushsha mimmela hi, velav ihu ka tarach abbatra.
Gavya[] (ihu) bechovo, chazenan i it leh ara achariti vaamar: hay baena, leokoma kammeh lokeach ka bae.
Vei la, zuze hu devae ipperoe.

Yahava nihaleh bemattana, peligi ba rav acha veravina. chad amar: mattana kirushsha, deha mimmela. vechad amar: mattana kemecher, dei lav detarach veartzi kammeh la have yahev leh mattana, lehachi terach veartzi kammeh, ki hechi delekum behemanuteh.
Vead emat nicha leh delekum behemanuteh? amar rav huna: ad sheat haamada baddin.
Chiyyay bar rav amar: ad demat[ya]1 adrachta lideh. rav pappa amar: ad dematchalin yome achrazta.
Matkef la rame bar chama: mikkedi hay lokeach bemay kane lehay ara – behay shetara, hay shetara chaspa bealma hu!
Amar leh rava: tehe bemaamino, behahi hanaa dela kaamar leh midde veka samech aleh tarach umayyte leh, gamar umakne leh.

Metiv rav sheshet: ma sheirash meabba machur lach, ma shettaale metzudati machur lach – lo amar kelum. ma sheirash min abba hayyom machur lach, ma shettaale metzudati hayyom machur lach – devarav kayyaymin!
Amar rame bar chama: ha gavra veha teyuveta!

Amar rava: gavra ka chazena, uteyuveta la ka chazena. hacha samcha dateh, vehacha la samcha dateh. hacha samcha dateh – deazel tarach umayyte leh ki hechi, dela nikreyeh "gazlana". hacha la samcha dateh.
Shalchuha lekammeh derabbi abba bar zavda. amar lehu: zo enah tzericha lifnim. amar rava: zo tzericha lifnim velifnay lifnim. hacha samcha dateh, vehacha la samcha dateh.
Hava ovada befumebdita veotveh. amar lehu rav yosef: zo enah tzericha lefanim. vaamar leh abbaye: tzericha lifnim velifnay lifnim, hacha samcha dateh, hacha la samcha dateh.
Umay shena resha umay shena sefa? amar rabbi yochanan: sefa "ma sheirash meabba hayyom" – mishshum kevod aviv. "ma shettaale metzudati hayyom" –
b: Mishshum kede chayyav.
Amar rav huna amar rav: haomer lachavero sade sheani lokeach, lichsheekkachenna, kenuya lach meachshav – kana.
Amar rava: mistabbera millete derav besade setam. aval besade zo – la. mi yemar dimzabben la nihaleh.
Vehaelohim! amar rav: afillu besade zo" mikkede rav keman amra lishmateh – kerabbi meir, deamar: adam makne davar shello ba laolam.

Detanya: haomer leishsha "hitkaddeshi li leachar sheetgayyer", "leachar shettitgayyeyri", "leachar sheeshtachrer", "leachar shettishtachreri", "leachar sheyyamut balich", "leachar sheyyachlotz lach yevamich", "leachar shettamut achotich" – enah mekuddeshet.
Rabbi meir omer: mekuddeshet.
Veha ishsha kesade zo" damya, veamar rabbi meir: mekuddeshet.

Amar shemuel: hammotze shetar hakenaa bashshuk – yachziro labbealim. dei mishshum dechatav lilvot velo lava – ha shabed nafsheh. vei mishshum peraon – la chayyshinan leferaon, deim ita defareh – mikra hava kara leh.
Amar rav nachman: abba min safre dayyayne demar shemuel hava, vahavena kevar sheta kevar sheva, udechirna dahavo machrezi veamri: hane shetare akneyayta demishtachchi beshuka, nahderinhu lemarayyhu.
Amar rav amram: af anan tenena. kol maase bet din – hare ze yachzir, alma la chayyshinan leferaon. amar leh rabbi zera: matnitin bishtare chaltata veadrachta, delav bene feraon ninhu.
Amar rava: vehane lav bene feraon ninhu? veha amri nehardae: shuma hadar ad teresar yarche shatta. veamar ammemar: ana minnehardea ana, usevira li deshuma hadar leolam.
Ella amar rava, hatam hayeynu tama: daamari ihu hu deafsed annafsheh, dividdana defareh ibbei leh lemikreeh lishtareh, i name lemichtav shetara acharina illaveh.
Demiddina ara la baaya lemehdar, umishshum "veasita hayyashar vehattov beene Adonai" hu daamur rabbanan tehdar. hilkach meresha hu deka zaven, ibbei leh lemichtav shetar zevine.

Gabbe shetar chov may ikka lememar? im ita defareh, ibbei leh lemikreeh lishtareh. emor ishtemote ka mishtemit leh, deamar leh: limchar yahevna lach dehashta leteh gabbay, i name appeshite desafra zayer leh.
Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: hammotze shetar chov bashshuk, af al pi shekkatuv bo henpek – lo yachziro labbealim.
La mibbaya hecha delo katuv bo henpek, deikka lememar katav lilvot velo lava. ella afillu katuv bo henpek, umay nihu? dimkuyyam – lo yachzir, dechayyshinan leferaon.
Etiveh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi avahu: kol maase bet din hare ze yachzir! amar leh yirmeya beri: lo kol maase bet din shavim, ella kegon shehuchezak kafran.
Amar rava: umishshum dehuchezak kafran chada zimna tu la para kelal?! ella amar rava: matnitin bishtar chaltata veadrachta, vechidrabbi zera.
Vechafran, hoil vaata lidan nema veh milleta. deamar rav yosef bar minyome amar rav nachman, amru lo: "tze ten lo",

a: Veamar "parati" – neeman. ba malve lichtov – en kotvin venotnin lo.
"Chayyayv atta litten lo" veamar "parati" – eno neeman. ba malve lichtov – kotvin venotnin lo.
Rav zevid mishshemeh derav nachman amar: ben "tze ten lo", ben "chayyayv atta litten lo", veamar "parati" – neeman. ba malve lichtov – en kotvin venotnin lo.
Ella i ikka lefalloge – hachi hu deikka lefalloge: amru lo "tze ten lo", veamar "parati", vehaedim meidin oto shello perao, vechazar veamar "parati" – huchezak kafran leoto mamon.
"Chayyayv atta litten lo", veamar "parati", vehaedim meidin oto shello para, vechazar veamar "parati" – lo huchezak kafran leoto mamon.
May tama? ishtemote hu ka mishtemit minneh, savar ad dimayyeynu bi rabbanan bedini.
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: "mane li beyadcha", vehalla omer: "en lecha beyadi kelum", vehaedim meidim oto sheyyesh lo, vechazar veamar: "parati" – huchezak kafran leoto mamon.

Ki ha deshabbetay bereh derabbi marinus ketav la lechalleteh itztela demelata bichtubbeta, vekabbela aleh. irchas ketubbeta. amar la: "la hayu devarim meolam". ato sahade veamri: in ketav la. lesof amar lehu: "peratiha". ata lekammeh derabbi chiyyay, amar leh: huchezakta kafran leotah itztela.
Amar rabbi avin amar rabbi ila amar rabbi yochanan: haya chayyayv lachavero shevua, veamar "nishbati", vehaedim meidin oto shello nishba, vechazar veamar "nishbati" – huchezak kafran leotah shevua.

Amruha kammeh derabbi avahu, amar lehu: mistabbera milleta derabbi avin shennitchayyev shevua bevet din, aval chiyyev atzmo shevua – [neeman]. aved inish demikkere veamar. ahderuha kammeh derabbi avin, amar lehu: ana name bevet din amari.

Ittemar name, amar rabbi avin amar rabbi ila amar rabbi yochanan: haya chayyayv lachavero shevua bevet din veamar "nishbati" vehaedim meidin oto shello nishba, vechazar veamar "nishbati" – huchezak kafran leotah shevua.
Amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: hammotze shetar chov bashshuk, vechatuv bo henpek, vechatuv bo zemanno bo bayyom – yachziro labbealim.
I mishshum katav lilvot velo lava – ha katuv bo henpek. i mishshum peraon – lifria bat yoma la chayyshinan.
Amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi assi: mi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? ha at hu deamrat mishshemeh derabbi yochanan: shetar shellava bo uferao – eno chozer velove bo, shekkevar nimchal shibudo.
Emat? illema limchar uleyoma chara, may irya shekkevar nimchal shibudo? tippok leh dehave leh mukedam, utenan: shitre chov hammukedamin – pesulin.
Ella lav beyomeh. alma pari inashe beyomeh!
Amar leh: mi ka amena dela pari kelal, dela shechichi inashe defari beyomeh ka amena.
Rav kahana amar: keshechayyayv mode. i hachi may lememra?

Mahu detema: hay mifra pareh, vehay deka amar la perateh, mishshum dekavae mehdar lemezfa beh zimna achariti, velifshite desafra chayesh, ka mashma lan deim ken malve gufeh la shavek. savar: shami be rabbanan umafsedi li.
May shena meha ditnan: matza shitre chov, im yesh bahen achrayut nechasim – lo yachazir,
Veokimna, keshechayyayv mode. umishshum shemma katav lilvot benisan velo lava ad tishre, veate lemitraf lakochot minnisan vead tishre shello kaddin.
Vela amrinan deim ken malve gufeh la shavek. deamar leh: ketov shetara acharina betishri, dedilma shami rabbanan umafsedi li!

Amri: hatam, mishshum deit leh ravvcha deka taref lakochot minnisan vead tishre, menach nicha leh vela amar vela midde. hacha, kevan delet leh ravvcha, desof sof shetara haiddana ketiv, may ikka – dekataref lakochot? bishtar shennimchal shibudo la shavek.
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: hattoen achar maase bet din –
b: Lo amar kelum. may tama? kol maase bet din – keman denaket shetara bideh dame.
Amar leh rabbi chiyyay bar abba lerabbi yochanan: velo mishnatenu hi zo? hotzia get veen immo ketubba – gova ketubbatah.
Amar leh: i lav dedallay lach chaspa, la mashkachat marganita tuta.
Amar abbaye: may marganita? dilma bimkom sheen kotvin ketubba askinan, deget hayeynu ketubbeta. aval bimkom shekkotvin ketubba, i nekita ketubba – gavya, i la – la gavya.

Hadar amar abbaye: lav milleta hi deamri, dei salka datach bimkom sheen kotvin ketubba askinan, aval bimkom shekkotvin ketubba, i nekita ketubba – gavya, i la – la gavya, almana min haerusin bemay gavya?
Beede mitat baal – liton velema: peratiha. vechi tema: hachi name, im ken ma hoilu chachamim betakkanatan?
Amar leh mar kashshisha bereh derav chisda lerav ashe: vealmana min haerusin, deit la ketubba mena lan?
Illema meha ditnan: nitarmela o nitgarsha, ben min haerusin uven min hannissuin – gova et hakkol, dilma hecha dichtav la?
Vechi tema: may lememra?! leappoke midderabbi elazar ben azarya, deamar shello katav lah ella al menat lechonsah itztericha leh.
Dayka name, dekatane: gova et hakkol. i amrat bishlama dichtav la, hayeynu deka tane gove et hakkol. ella i amrat dela ketav la,

a: May "gova et hakkol"? mane umatayim hu deit la.
Veella, middetane rav chiyyay bar amme: ishto arusa, lo onen velo mittamme lah, vechen hi lo onenet velo mittammea lo. meta – eno yorshah, met hu – gova ketubbatah.
Dilma dichtav la, vechi tema: dichtav la, may lememra? meta eno yorshah itztericha leh.
Ella abbaye miggufa dematnitin ka hadar beh, dei salka datach bimkom sheen kotvin ketuva askinan, deget hayeynu ketubbeta, attu get mane matayim ketiv beh?
Vechi tema: kevan detakkinu rabbanan lemigbe (la) [beh] keman dichtiv beh dame, liton velema parati.
Vechi tema deamrinan leh: i perata ibbei lach lemikreeh, amar lan: la shevaktan, amra: baena leinnesove beh.
Vechi tema amrinan leh: ibbei lach lemikreeh umichtav aggabbeh, gitta denan dikranuhv la mishshum degitta pesula hu, ella ki hechi dela tigbe beh zimna achariti. attu kol demagbe, beve dina magbe?
Mishna matza gitte nashim veshichrure avadim, deyayteke, mattana, veshovarin – hare ze lo yachazir. sheani omer: ketuvin hayu, venimlach alehen shello littenan.
Gemara tama denimlach shello littenan, ha amar: "tenu" – notnin, vaafillu lizman merubbe.
Ureminhu: hammevi get, veavad hemennu – metzao lealtar kasher, im lav – pasul.
Amar rabba, la kashya: kan – bimkom shehashsheyayrot metzuyot, kan – bimkom sheen hashshayyayrot metzuyot.
Vaafillu bimkom shehashsheyayrot metzuyot – vehu shehuchezku shene yosef ben shimon beir achat.
Dei la tema hachi, kashya derabba adderabba. dehahu gitta deishtechach be dina derav huna, dahava ketivv beh bishvire mata deal rachis nahara. amar rav huna:
b: Chayyshinan lishne shevire, vaamar leh rav chisda lerabba: pok ayyen bah, dilureta bae minnach rav huna. nefak, dak veashkach. ditnan: kol maase bet din – hare ze yachazir.
Veha be dina derav huna, dechi mekom shehashsheyayrot metzuyot dame, veka pashet rabba deyachzir, alma i huchezku shene yosef ben shimon – in, i la – la.
Avad rabba ovada behahu gitta deishtechach be chittana defumebdita kishmateh.
Ikka deamri: hecha dimzabbeni kittana vehu shello huchezku, af al gav dishchichan sheyayrata.
Veikka deamri: hecha detaru kittana veaf al gav dehuchezku, dela (shechicha sheyayrot).

Rabbi zera rame matnitin abbarayyta umeshanne. tenan: hammevi get veavad hemennu, metzao lealtar – kasher, veim lav – pasul. ureminhi: matza get ishsha bashshuk, bizman shehabbaal mode – yachzir leishsha. en habbaal mode – lo yachzir lo laze velo laze.
Katane mihat bizman shehabbaal mode – yachzir laishsha, vaafillu lizman merubbe!
Umeshanne: kan bimkom shehashsheyayrot metzuyot, vechan bimkom sheen hashsheyayrot metzuyot.
Ikka deamri: vehu shehuchezku dela nahdar, vehayeynu derabba. ikka deamri: af al gav dela huchezku la nahdar, ufeliga derabba.
Bishlama rabba la amar kerabbi zera, matnitin allima leh leakshoye. ella rabbi zera, may tama la amar kerabba?
Amar lach, mi ka tane: ha amar "tenu" – notnin vaafillu lizman merubbe? dilma ha amar "tenu" – notnin, uleolam kidkayyma lan lealtar.
Leman deamar lerabbi zera bimkom shehashsheyayrot metzuyot, veaf al gav shello huchezku shene yosef ben shimon, ufeliga derabba, bemay ka mippalgi?
Rabba savar dekatane kol maase bet din hare ze yachzir, deishtechach bevet din askinan, uvet din kimkom shehashsheyayrot metzuyot, vehu shehuchezku – lo yachzir, lo huchezku – yachzir.
Verabbi zera amar lach: mi katane "kol maase bet din shennimtzeu bevet din"? "kol maase bet din yachzir" katane, uleolam deishtechach abbaray.
Rabbi yirmeya amar, kegon deka amri edim: meolam lo chatamnu ella al get echad shel yosef ben shimon.
I hachi, may lememra? mahu detema lechush dilma itremi shema kishma, veedim keedim, ka mashma lan.
Rav ashe amar, kegon deka amar: nekev yesh bo betzad ot pelonit.
Vedavka betzad ot pelonit, aval nekev bealma – la.
Rav ashe mesappeka leh simanim i deorayyta i derabbanan.
Rabba bar bar chana

a: Irchas leh gitta be midresha. amar: i simana – it li begavveh, i teviut ena – it li begavveh. ahderu nihaleh. amar: la yadana i mishshum simana ahderu nihali, veka savri simanin deorayyta. i mishshum teviut ena ahderu nihali, vedavka tzureba midderabbanan. aval inish dealma – la.
Gufa: matza get ishsha bashshuk, bizman shehabbaal mode – yachzir leishsha. en habbaal mode – lo yachzir lo laze velo laze.

Bizman shehabbaal mode miha yachzir laishsha. velechush shemma katav litten benisan velo natan lah ad tishre, vaazal baal zabben pere minnisan vead tishre, umappeka legitta dichtiv benisan, veatya lemitraf lakochot shello kaddin.
Hanicha leman deamar kevan shennatan enav legarshah shuv en labbaal perot – shappir. ella leman deamar yesh labbaal perot ad sheat netina, may ikka lememar?
Ki atya lemitraf amrinan la: ayytay reaya emat meta gitta leyadcha.

Umay shena mishshetare chov? ditnan: matza shetare chov, im yesh bahen achrayut nechasim – lo yachzir. veokemna keshechayyayv mode, umishshum shemma katav lilvot benisan velo lava ad tishre veka taref lakochot shello kaddin.
Hatam name lihdar, vechi ate lemitraf nema leh: ayyti reaya emat meta shetar chov leyadach!
Amri, hacha gabbe get ishsha ate lokeach vetavao, amar: hay d[a]hedru nihala rabbanan legitta, mishshum dela tiagin vetetiv. hasheta deka atya lemitraf – tezil vetayte reaya emat meta gitta lida.

Hacha gabbe shetar chov la ate lokeach vetava, [amar] middeahderu nihaleh rabbanan lishtar chov, peshita lemay hilcheta ahderu nihaleh – lemitraf hu, shema minna kamu rabbanan bemilleta, umikkamme didi meta shetara lideh.
Shichrure avadim vechulei. tanu rabbanan: matza shetar shichrur beshuk, bizman sheharav mode – yachzir laeved, en harav mode – lo yachzir lo laze velo laze.

Bizman sheharav mode miha yachzir laeved, veammay? nechush shemma katav litten lo benisan velo natan lo ad tishre, vaazal avda ukena nichsin minnisan vead tishre, vaazayl harav vezabbeninhu umappek leh leshichrur dichtiv benisan, veka taref lakochot shello kaddin.

Hanicha leman deamar zechut hu laeved sheyyotze mittachat rabbo lecherut, ucheabbaye deamar: edav bachatumav zachin leh, shappir. ella leman deamar chov hu laeved sheyyotze mittachat rabbo lecherut, may ikka lememar?
Dechi ate lemitraf amrinan leh: ayyti reaya emat meta shichrur leyadach.
Deyayteke mattana vechulei. tanu rabbanan: ezo hi deyayteke – da tehe lemekam velihyot sheim met nechasav lifloni. mattana – kol shekkatuv bo "mehayyom uleachar mita".
Alma i ketiva "mehayyom uleachar mita" hu dekane, vei la – la kane?!
Amar abbaye, hachi kaamar: ezo hi mattenat bari shehi kemattenat shechiv mera, dela kane ella leachar mita, kol shekkatuv bah "mehayyom uleachar mita".
Tama dela amar "tenu". ha amar "tenu" – notnin.
Ureminhu: matza deyaytekaot, appotekaot umattanot, af al pi sheshshenehem modin – lo yachzir lo laze velo laze!
Amar rabbi abba bar memel: la kashya,
b: Ha bevari, veha bishchiv mera.
Matnitin dekatane: ha amar tenu notnin – bishchiv mera, devar mihdar hu.
Deamrinan, may ikka lememar: dilma katva meikkara lehay veimmelich vela yahava nihaleh, vahadar katva leinish acharina veyahavay nihaleh – hasheta ka hadar beh mehahu deyahava nihaleh.
I bemattenat bari yahava leh – let leh peseda, dechi nafka tarte, batrayyta zache, deha hadar beh mikkammayyta.
I bemattenat shechiv mera name yahava nihaleh, let ba peseda – devatrayyta zache, deka hadar beh mikkammayyta.
Ki katane bevarayyta: af al pi sheshshenehem modim lo yachzir lo laze velo laze – bevari, delav bar mihdar hu,

Deamrinan: dilma katva lehay meikkara veimmelich vela yahava leh, vahadar katva leinish acharina veyahava leh – hasheta ka hadar beh mehahu deyahava leh vesavar: mihdar la matzena hadarna bi, emar lehu daana lehay yahavita, venayhderu nihaleh ketava, ki hechi dechi mappek hay ketava, dekadem zache beh hu.

Ella amrinan leh anan: hay ketava la yahavinan leh lehay. dilma michtav ketavt, mehav la yehavt nihaleh, vihavta leinish acharina veka hadrat beh. i la yehavta leinish acharina veka baet detitteva lehay, ketov leh hasheta ketava acharina veyahaveh nihaleh, dei yahavat leinish acharina let ba peseda, dekadem zache.
Matkef la rav zevid: veha idde veidde deyaytekaot ka tane! ella amar rav zevid: ha veha bishchiv mera, vela kashya: ha beh, veha bivreh!
Deka amar "tenu" notnin, bedideh devar mihdar hu, deamrinan: i name yahava leinish acharina let ba peseda, dekamma uvatra – batra zache, deha hadar beh mikkamma.
Ki ka tane bevarayyta: af al pi sheshshenehem modim, lo yachzir lo laze velo laze, bivreh.

Deamrinan: dilma ketav avu lehay, veimmelich vela yahavay nihaleh, uvatar avu ketav ihu leinish acharina veyahava leh, vehasheta ka hadar beh mehahu. savar: mihdar la matzena hadarna bi. emar lehu deabba yahava leh lehay, venittevu leh ketaveh, venezil venappek minneh dehu zache veniflog bahadeh.
Hilkach amrinan leh anan: hay ketava la yahavinan leh lehay, dedilma michtav katveh avu mehav la yahava leh, vihavteh at leinish acharina veka hadrat beh.
Ella i kusheta ka amrat, dihav leh avuch – zil at hasheta ketov leh shetara acharina, dei name la yahava leh avu uchetavteh at leinish acharina – let ba peseda, dekamma uvatra – kamma zache.
Tanu rabbanan: matza shovar, bizman shehaishsha mode – yachzir labbaal. en haishsha mode – lo yachzir lo laze velo laze.
Bizman shehaishsha mode mihat yachzir labbaal, velechush dilma katva litten benisan, velo natna ad tishre, vaazala zeventa lichtub[ta] betovat hanaa minnisan ad tishre.
Umappek leh leshovar dichtiv benisan, veate lemitraf lakochot shello kaddin!
Amar rava:

a: Shema minna: ita ledishmuel, deamar shemuel: hammocher shetar chov lachavero, vechazar umechalo – machul, vaafillu yoresh mochel.
Abbaye amar: afillu tema letay ledishmuel, hacha bemay askinan – besheshshetar ketubba yotze mittachat yadah. verava amar: i mishshum shetar ketubba, chayyshinan lishte chetubbot.
Veabbaye amar, chada: lishte chetubbot la chayyshinan. veod, shovar bizmanno taref. abbaye letameh, deamar: edav bachatumav zachin lo.
Mishna matza iggerot shum veiggerot mazon, shetare chalitza umeunin, ushetare verurin, vechol maase bet din – hare ze yachzir.

Matza bachafisa o vidloskama, tachrich shel shetarot o agudda shel shetarot – hare ze yachzir. vechamma agudda shel shetarot – shelosha keshurin ze baze. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: echad hallove mishshelosha – yachzir lallove. shelosha hallovin min haechad – yachzir lammalve.
Matza shetar ben shetarotav veeno yodea ma tivo – yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu. im yesh immahen simponot, yaase ma shebbassimponot.
Gemara may "shetare verurin"? hacha targimu shetare taanata. rabbi yirmeya amar: ze borer lo echad veze borer lo echad.
Vechol maase bet din hare ze yachzir. hahu gitta deishtechach be dina derav huna, dahava ketiv beh "bishvire mata deal rachis nahara". amar rav huna:
b: Chayyshinan lishne shevire. amar leh rav chisda lerabba: pok ayyen, dilureta bae la rav huna minnach. nefak dak veashkach, ditnan: kol maase bet din hare ze yachzir.
Amar leh rav amram lerabba: hechi pashet mar issura mimmamona? amar leh: terada, "shetare chalitza umeunin" tenan.
Peka arza deve rav. mar amar: mishshum lattay didi peka. umar amar: mishshum lattay didi peka.
Matza bachafisa o vidloskama. may chafisa? amar rabba bar bar chana: chemet ketanna. may deloskama? amar rabba bar shemuel: telika desave.
Tachrich shel shetarot o agudda shel shetarot vechulei. tanu rabbanan: kamma hu tachrich shel shetarot? shelosha keruchin ze baze. vechamma hi agudda shel shetarot? shelosha keshurin ze baze.
Shamat minna kesher siman.
Ha tane rabbi chiyyay: shelosha keruchin ze baze.
I hachi, hayeynu tachrich? tachrich kol chad vechad bereshe dechavreh, agudda dirmu ahadade (ucheruchot).
May machriz, minyan?
May irya telata afillu teren name!
Ella kidamar ravina: tiva machrez, hacha name "shetare" machrez.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: echad hallove mishshelosha yachzir lallove vechulei. dei salka datach demalvin ninhu, may bau gabbe hadade?
Dilma lekayyominhu azli? dimkayyeymi.
Dilma mida desafra neful? la meshahe inish kiyyumeh bida desafra.
Shelosha shellavu meechad yachzir lammalve vechulei. dei salka datach delovin ninhu, may bau gabbe hadade?
Dilma lemichtevinhu azul? dichtivi bitlat yede safre.
Vedilma lekayyominhu azul? malve mekayyem shetareh, love la mekayyem shetareh.
Im yesh immahen simponot – yaase ma shebbassimponot. amar rav yirmeya bar abba amar rav: simpon hayyotze mittachat yede malve, af al pi shekkatuv bichtav yado – eno ella kimsachek, ufasul.

La mibbaya katuv bichtav yad sofer, deikka lememar safra itremi leh uchetav, ella afillu katuv bichtav yado pasul. savar dilma mitreme veate ben hashshemashot veka fara li, dei la yahevna leh la yahev li zuze, echtov ana dechi (ayytay) [mayyte] li zuzay etten leh.
Tenan: im yesh immahen simponot, yaase ma shebbesimponot.
Kidamar rav safra: shennimtza ben shetarot keruin, hacha name shemmetzao ben shetarot keruin.
Ta shema: nimtza leechad ben shetarotav shetaro shel yosef ben shimon parua – shetarot shenehem peruin!
Kidamar rav safra: shennimtza ben shetarot keruin, hacha name shennimtza ben shetarot keruin.
Ta shema: "shevua shello pekadanu abba, veshello amar lanu abba, veshello matzanu ben shetarotav shel abba sheshshetar ze parua".
Amar rav safra: shennimtza ben shetarot keruin.
Ta shema: simpon sheyyesh alav edim yitkayyem bechotmav. ema "yitkayyem mechotmav"!

a: Deshayylinan lehu lesahadi i parua i la parua.
Ta shema: simpon sheyyesh alav edim – kasher. may edim? ede kiyyum.
Hachi name mistabbera, middekatane sefa: vesheen alav edim – pasul. may "en alav edim"? illema delekka illaveh edim kelal, tzericha lememar defasul?! ella lav ede kiyyum.
Gufa. simpon sheyyesh alav edim – yitkayyem bechotmav. en alav edim veyotze mittachat yede shalish, o sheyyotze leachar chittum shetarot – kasher.
Yotze mittachat yede shalish, deha hemneh malve leshalish. yotze leachar chittum shetarot name, dei lav difria la hava mara leh lishtareh.
Hadaran alach shenayim ochazin
Mishna ellu metziot shello, veellu chayyayv lehacheriz.

Ellu metziot shello: matza perot mefuzzarin, maot mefuzzarot, kerichot birshut harabbim, veiggule devela, kikkarot shel nachtom, machrozot shel dagim, vachatichot shel basar, vegizze tzemer hallekuchin mimmedinatan, vaanitze fishtan, uleshonot shel argaman – hare ellu shello, divre rabbi meir.
Rabbi yehuda omer: kol sheyyesh bo shinnuy – chayyayv lehacheriz. ketzad? matza iggul uvetocho cheres, kikkar uvetocho maot.
Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: kol kele anpureya en chayyayv lehacheriz.
Gemara matza perot mefuzzarin. vechamma? amar rabbi yitzchak: kav bearba ammot.
Hechi dame? i derech nefila – afillu tuva name! vei derech hinnuach – afillu betzir mehachi name la!

Amar rav ukeva bar chama: bemachnashta deve dare askinan. kav bearba ammot dinfish tirchayyhu – la tarach inish vela hadar ate veshakel lehu, afkore mafkar lehu. betzir mehachi – tarach vehadar ate veshakel lehu, vela mafkar lehu.

Bae rabbi yirmeya: chatzi kav bishte ammot, mahu? kav bearba ammot, tama may – mishshum dinfish tirchayyhu. chatzi kav bishte ammot, kevan dela nefish tirchayyhu – la mafkar lehu. o dilma: mishshum dela chashivi, vachatzi kav bishte ammot, kevan dela chashivi – mafkar lehu.

Kabbayim bishmone ammot, mahu? kav bearba ammot, tama may – mishshum dinfish tirchayyhu, vechol shekken kabbayim bishmone ammot, kevan dinfisho tirchayyhu tefe – mafkar lehu. o dilma: mishshum dela chashivi, vekabbayim bishmone ammot, kevan dachashivi – la mafkar lehu.

Kav shumeshmin bearba ammot, mahu? kav bearba ammot tama may – mishshum dela chashivi, veshumeshmin kevan dachashivi – la mafkar lehu. o dilma: mishshum dinfish tirchayyhu, vechol shekken shumeshmin, kevan dinfish tirchayyhu tefe – mafkar lehu.
Kav tamre bearba ammot, kav rimmone bearba ammot, mahu? kav bearba ammot, tama may? mishshum dela chashivi. kav tamre bearba ammot, kav rimmone bearba ammot name, kevan dela chashivi – mafkar lehu.
O dilma: mishshum dinfisho tirchayyhu, vekav tamre bearba ammot, vekav rimmone bearba ammot, kevan dela nefish tirchayyhu – la mafkar lehu. may? teku.
Ittemar:
b: Yeush shello middaat, abbaye amar: la have yeush. verava amar: have yeush.

Bedavar sheyyesh bo siman – kulle alma la peligi dela have yeush. veaf al gav deshamineh demiyyaash lesof, la have yeush, dechi ata lideh – beissura hu daata lideh, dilchi yada dinfal minneh la miyyaash, memar amar: simana it li begavveh, yahevna simana veshakelna leh.
Bezuto shel yam uvishlulito shel nahar, af al gav deit beh siman, rachamana sharyeh, kidvaenan lememar lekamman.

Ki peligi bedavar sheen bo siman. abbaye amar: la have yeush, deha la yada dinfal minneh. rava amar: have yeush, dilchi yada dinfal minneh – miyyaash. memar amar: simana let li begavveh, mehasheta hu demiyyaash.
Ta shema: perot mefuzzarin, ha la yada dinfal minneh! ha amar rav ukeva bar chama: hacha bemachnashta (devizre) [deve dare] askinan, daaveda middaat hi.

Ta shema: maot mefuzzarot – hare ellu shello, ammay? ha la yada dinfal minneh! hatam name kidrabbi yitzchak deamar: adam asuy lemashmesh bechiso bechol shaa veshaa. hacha name adam asuy lemashmesh bechiso bechol shaa veshaa.
Ta shema: iggule devela vechikkarot shel nachtom – hare ellu shello. ammay? veha la yada dinfal minneh? hatam name, aggav deyakkire midda yada behu.
Ta shema: uleshonot shel argaman – hare ellu shello. veammay? ha la yada dinfal minneh! hatam name, aggav dachashivi mashmushe memashmesh behu, vechidrabbi yitzchak.

Ta shema: hammotze maot bevatte chenesiyyot uvevatte midrashot, uvechol makom sheharabbim metzuyin sham – hare ellu shello, mippene shehabbealim mityaashin mehen. veha la yada dinfal minneh? amar rabbi yitzchak: adam asuy lemashmesh bechiso bechol shaa.
Ta shema: meematay kol adam muttarim balleket? mishsheyyelchu bah hannamoshot. veamrinan: may namoshot? veamar rabbi yochanan: save deazli attigra. resh lakish amar: lakote batar lakote.
Veammay? nehi daaniyyim dehacha miyyaashi – ikka aniyyim beducheta achrita dela miyyaashi! amri: kevan deikka aniyyim hacha, hanach meikkara iyyaoshe miyyaash, veamri: aniyyim dehatam melakketi leh.
Ta shema: ketziot badderech, vaafillu betzad sede ketziot, vechen teena hannota ladderech, umatza teenim tachteha – muttarot mishshum gazel, ufeturot min hammaaser. bezetim uvecharuvim – asur.
Bishlama resha leabbaye la kashya: aggav dachashivi – memashmesh behu. teena name midda yedia denatra.
Ella sefa lerava kashya, dekatane "bezetim uvecharuvim asur", amar rabbi avahu: shane zayit, hoil vechazuto mochiach alav, veaf al gav denatrin zete midda yedia, ducheta deinish inish hu.
I hachi, afillu resha name! amar rav pappa: teena im nefilatah nimeset.
Ta shema: haggannav shennatal mizze venatan laze, vechen gazlan shennatal mizze venatan laze,

a: Vechen yarden shennatal mizze venatan laze, ma shennatal – natal, uma shennatan – natan.
Bishlama gazlan veyarden, deka chaze lehu umiyyaash. ella gannav, mi ka chaze leh demiyyaash? targema rav pappa belistim mezuyyan. i hachi hayeynu gazlan! tere gavvne gazlan.

Ta shema: shataf nahar korav, etzav, vaavanav, unetano betoch sede chavero – hare ellu shello, mippene shennityaashu habbealim. tama denityaashu habbealim, ha setama – la! hacha bemay askinan? kesheyyachol lehatztzil.

I hachi ema sefa: im hayu habbealim meraddefin acharehem – chayyayv lehachezir. i bicholin lehatztzil, may irya meraddefin? afillu en meraddefin name! hacha bemay askinan? bicholin lehatztzil al yede haddechak. meraddefin – la iyyayush, en meraddefin – iyyayoshe miyyaash.

Ta shema: ketzad amru hattorem shello middaat terumato teruma – hare sheyyarad letoch sede chavero velikket vetaram shello birshut, im choshesh mishshum gazel – en terumato teruma, veim lav – terumato teruma.

Uminnayin hu yodea im choshesh mishshum gazel veim lav? hare shebba baal habbayit umetzao, veamar lo: "kelach etzel yafot". im nimtzeu yafot mehen – terumato teruma, veim lav – en terumato teruma. likketu habbealim vehosifu alehen, ben kach uven kach – terumato teruma.
Vechi nimtzeu yafot mehen terumato teruma, ammay? beiddana ditram ha la hava yada! targema rava allibba deabbaye: deshavveye shaliach.
