Hachi name mistabbera, dei salka datach dela shavvevye shaliach, mi havya terumato teruma? veha "attem" "gam attem" amar rachamana lerabbot sheluchachem. ma attem ledatechem, af sheluchachem ledatechem.

Ella hacha bemay askinan – kegon deshavveye shaliach, vaamar leh: "zil terom", vela amar leh "terom mehane". usetameh devaal habbayit ki tarem mibbenonit (hu) tarem, vaazal ihu uteram miyyafot, uva baal habbayit umetzao vaamar leh: "kelach etzel yafot", im nimtzeu yafot mehen – terumato teruma, veim lav – en terumato teruma.

Ammemar umar zutera verav ashe ikkelau levusetana demari bar isak, ayyti ariseh tamre verimmone usheda kammayyhu. ammemar verav ashe achli, mar zutera la achal. addehachi ata mari bar isak, ashkechinhu, vaamar leh laariseh: ammay la ayytet lehu lerabbanan mehanach shappirata?

Amaru leh ammemar verav ashe lemar zutera: hasheta ammay la achel mar? vehatanya: im nimtzeu yafot mehen – terumato teruma! amar lehu, hachi amar rava: lo amru kelach etzel yafot ella leinyan teruma bilvad, mishshum demitzva hu venicha leh, aval hacha – mishshum kesifuta hu deamar hachi.
Ta shema: odehu hattal alehen vesamach – hare ze bechi yuttan. niggevu, af al pi shessamach –
b: Enan bechi yuttan.
Tama may? lav mishshum dela amrinan kevan deiggallay milleta dehashta nicha leh, meikkara name nicha leh? shane hatam, dichtiv "ki yitten". ad sheyyitten.
I hachi, resha name: hatam kidrav pappa. derav pappa rame, ketiv "ki yitten", vekarenan ki yuttan! ha ketzad?
Baenan "ki yuttan" duvmya "dechi yitten". ma "yitten" ledaat, af "ki yuttan" name ledaat.

Ta shema deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yishmael ben yehotzadak: minnayin laaveda sheshshetafah nahar shehi mutteret? dichtiv: "vechen taase lachamoro vechen taase lesimlato vechen taase lechol avedat achicha asher tovad mimmennu umetzatah". mi sheavuda hemennu umetzuya etzel kol adam, yatzata zo sheavuda mimmennu veenah metzuya etzel kol adam.
Veissura dumeya dehettera, ma hettera ben deit ba siman uven delet ba siman – sharya, af issura ben deit ba siman uven delet ba siman – asira. teyuveta derava, teyuveta!
Vehilcheta kevoteh deabbaye beyaal kaggam.

Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: vechi meachar deittotav rava – hane tamre dezika hechi achlinan lehu? amar leh: kevan deikka shekatzim uremasim deka achli lehu, meikkara yaoshe meyaash minnayyhu.
Yatme delav bene mechila ninhu, may? amar leh: baga beara deyatme la machzekinan.
Muchezak veomed, may? kerachta, may? amar leh: asiran.

Kerichot birshut harabbim – hare ellu shello. amar rabba: vaafillu bedavar sheyyesh bo siman. alma kasavar rabba: siman heasuy liddares la have siman. rava amar: lo shanu ella bedavar sheen bo siman, aval bedavar sheyyesh bo siman chayyayv lehacheriz. alma kasavar rava: siman heasuy liddares have siman.
Veikka dematne leha shemata beanpe nafsha: siman heasuy liddares, rabba amar: la have siman, verava amar: have siman.

Tenan: kerichot birshut harabbim – hare ellu shello, birshut hayyachid – notel umachriz. hechi dame? i delet behu siman, birshut hayyachid may machrez? ella lav deit behu siman, vekatane: birshut harabbim – hare ellu shello. alma siman heasuy liddares la have siman, teyuveta derava!

Amar lach rava: leolam delet behu siman, udeka amrat birshut hayyachid may machrez? machrez makom. verabba amar: makom la have siman. deittemar: makom, rabba amar: la have siman, verava amar: have siman.

Ta shema: kerichot birshut harabbim – hare ellu shello, birshut hayyachid – notel umachriz. vehaalummot, ben birshut harabbim ben birshut hayyachid – notel umachriz. rabba hechi metaretz la, verava hechi metaretz la? rabba metaretz letameh, besiman. verava metaretz letameh, bemakom.
Rabba metaretz letameh besiman: kerichot birshut harabbim – hare ellu shello, mishshum

a: Demiddarsa. birshut hayyachid – notel umachriz, dela middarsa. vehaalummot, ben birshut harabbim uven birshut hayyachid – notel umachriz, kevan digvihan la middarsa.

Verava metaretz letameh bemakom: kerichot birshut harabbim hare ellu shello – deminnashtefa. birshut hayyachid chayyayv lehacheriz – dela minnashtefa. vehaalummot, ben birshut harabbim, uven birshut hayyachid – notel umachriz, kevan deyakkire la minnashtefa.

Ta shema: kikkarot shel nachtom – hare ellu shello. ha shel baal habbayit chayyayv lehacheriz. shel baal habbayit may tama? kevan deit behu siman, demidda yedia rifta deinish inish hu. vela shena reshut harabbim vela shena reshut hayyachid – notel umachriz, alma siman heasuy liddares have siman, teyuveta derabba!
Amar lach rabba: hatam hayeynu tama – mishshum deen maavirin al haochalin. veha ikka goyim! goyim chayyshi lichshafim. vehaikka behema uchelavim! beatra dela shechichi behema uchelavim.
Lema ketannae: rabbi yehuda omer: kol davar sheyyesh bo shinnuy, chayyayv lehacheriz. ketzad? matza iggul uvetocho cheres, kikkar uvetocho maot. mikkelal detanna kamma savar hare ellu shello.
Savruha: dechulle alma siman habba meelav have siman, umaavirin al haochalin. may lav: besiman heasuy liddares ka mippalgi, mar savar: la have siman, umar savar: have siman?
Amar rav zevid mishshemeh derava: i salka datach deka savar tanna kamma siman heasuy liddares la have siman, umaavirin al haochalin, kikkarot shel baal habbayit birshut harabbim ammay machriz?

Ella, amar rav zevid mishshemeh derava: dechulle alma savri siman heasuy liddares have siman, umaavirin al haochalin. vehacha besiman habba meelav ka mippalgi, detanna kamma savar: siman habba meelav la have siman, verabbi yehuda savar: have siman.

Verabba amar lach: dechulle alma siman heasuy liddares – la have siman veen maavirin al haochalin. vehacha besiman habba meelav kamippalgi tanna kamma savar: la have siman, verabbi yehuda savar: have siman.
Ikka deamri, savruha: dechulle alma siman habba meelav have siman, vesiman heasuy liddares la have siman. may lav: bemaavirin al haochalin ka mippalgi, demar savar: maavirin, umar savar: en maavirin?
Amar rav zevid mishshemeh derava: i salka datach savar tanna kamma siman heasuy liddares la have siman, umaavirin al haochalin – kikkarot shel baal habbayit birshut harabbim ammay machriz?

Ella amar rav zevid mishshemeh derava: dechulle alma savri siman heasuy liddares – have siman, umaavirin al haochalin. vehacha besiman habba meelav ka mippalgi, detanna kamma savar: siman habba meelav – la have siman, verabbi yehuda savar: have siman.

Verabba amar lach: dechulle alma siman heasuy liddares – la have siman, veen maavirin al haochalin. vehacha besiman habba meelav ka mippalgi, tanna kamma savar: siman habba meelav – la have siman, verabbi yehuda savar: have siman.
Amar rav zevid mishshemeh derava: kelala daavedta kevan deamar "vavy le lechesron kis" – miyyaash leh minna.

Veamar rav zevid mishshemeh derava: hilcheta, kerichot birshut harabbim – hare ellu shello. birshut hayyachid, i derech nefila – hare ellu shello, i derech hannacha – notel umachriz. veze vaze bedavar sheen bo siman, aval bedavar sheyyesh bo siman – la shena birshut harabbim vela shena birshut hayyachid, ben derech nefila uven derech hannacha – chayyayv lehacheriz.
b: Umachrozot shel dagim. ammay? leheve kesher siman! bekitra detzayyayde, dechulle alma hachi mekatteri. veleheve minyan siman! beminyana deshavin.

Beo minneh merav sheshet: [minyan] have siman o la have siman? amar lehu rav sheshet: tenetuha, matza kele chesef uchele nechoshet, gisteron shel avar, vechol kele mattachot – hare ze lo yachazir ad sheyyitten ot, o ad sheyyechavven mishkelotav. umiddemishkal have siman, midda uminyan name have siman.

Vachatichot shel basar vechulei. ammay? leheve mashkela siman! bemashkela deshavin. veteheve chaticha gufa siman, o dedafka o deatma! mi la tanya: matza chatichot dagim vedag nashuch – chayyayv lehacheriz. chaviyyot shel yayin veshel shemen veshel tevua veshel gerogrot veshel zetim – hare ellu shello.
Hacha bemay askinan? bidikka simana bifsaka, ki ha derabba bar rav huna mechattech leh attelat karnata. dayka name dekatane dumeya dedag nashuch, shema minna.

Amar mar: chaviyyot shel yayin veshel shemen veshel tevua veshel gerogrot veshel zetim – hare ellu shello. veha tenan: kadde yayin vechadde shemen chayyayv lehacheriz! amar rabbi zera amar rav: matnitin berashum. mikkelal devarayyta befatuach, i befatuach – aveda middaat hi. amar rav hoshaya: bemetzif.

Abbaye amar: afillu tema idde veidde berashum, vela kashya: kan – kodem shenniftechu haotzarot, kan – leachar shenniftechu haotzarot. ki ha derav yaakov bar abba ashkach chavita dechamra leachar shenniftechu haotzarot, ata lekammeh deabbaye, amar leh: zil shekol lenafshach.

Bea minneh rav bivi merav nachman: makom have siman, o la have siman? amar leh: tenetuha, matza chaviyyot shel yayin veshel shemen veshel tevua veshel gerogrot veshel zetim – hare ellu shello. vei salka datach demakom have siman, lichroz makom! amar rav zevid, hacha bemay askinan? berakketa denahara.

Amar rav mari: may tama amaru rabbanan rakketa denahara la have siman? deamrinan leh: ki hechi deitremi ledidach itremi name lechavrach. ikka deamri, amar rav mari: may tama amaru rabbanan makom la have siman? deamrinan leh: ki hechi deitremi ledidach hay mekom, itremi name lechavrach hay makom.

Hahu gavra deashkach kufera be maatzarta, ata lekammeh derav, amar leh: zil shekol lenafshach. chazyeh dahava ka mechassem, amar leh: zil pelog leh lechiyyay beri minneh. lema ka savar rav makom la have siman? amar rabbi abba: mishshum yeush bealim nagu bah, dachaza dekadchi beh chilfe.

Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer vechulei. may anpureya? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kelim chadashim shello sevaatan haayin. hechi dame? i it behu siman – ki lo sevaatan haayin may have? i delet behu siman – ki sevaatan haayin may have?

Leolam delet behu siman – nafka minna leahdore letzureba merabbanan bitviut ena. sevaatan haayin – kim leh begavvayyhu umahderinan leh. ki lo sevaatan haayin – la kim leh begavvayyhu, vela mahderinan leh, deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: behane telat mille avidi rabbanan dimshannu bemillayyhu – bemassechet, uvefureya

a: Uveushepiza. may nafka minna? amar mar zutera: leahdore leh avedta bitviut ena. i yadinan beh dela meshanne ella behane telat – mahderinan leh, vei meshanne bemille acharine – la mahderinan leh.
Mar zutera chasida iggeniv leh kasa dechaspa meushepiza. chazye lehahu bar be rav demashe yedeh venagev biglima dechavreh. amar: hayeynu hay dela ichpat leh ammamona dechavreh. kafteh veodi.

Tanya: mode rabbi shimon ben elazar bechelim chadashim shessevaatan haayin shechayyayv lehacheriz. veellu hen kelim chadashim shello sevaatan haayin sheeno chayyayv lehacheriz, kegon badde mechatin, vetzinnoriyyot, umachrozot shel kardummot. kol ellu sheamru, ematay muttarim? bizman shemmetzaan echad echad, aval metzaan shenayim shenayim – chayyayv lehacheriz.
May "badde"? soche. veammay karu leh "badde"? davar detalu beh midde, "bad" karu leh. ki hahu ditnan hatam: ale echad bevad echad.

Vechen haya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: hammatztzil min haari umin haddov umin hannamer umin habbardelas umin zoto shel yam umishshelulito shel nahar, hammotze bisratya ufelatya gedola, uvechol makom sheharabbim metzuyin sham – hare ellu shello, mippene shehabbealim mityaashin mehen.
Ibbaya lehu: ki kaamar rabbi shimon ben elazar – berov goyim aval berov yisrael – la, o dilma afillu berov yisrael name amar?
Im timtza lomar afillu berov yisrael name amar, peligi rabbanan aleh, o la peligi?
Veim timtza lomar peligi, berov yisrael vadday peligi, berov goyim peligi o la peligi?
Veim timtza lomar peligi afillu berov goyim halacha kemoto o en halacha kemoto?
Im timtza lomar halacha kemoto, davka berov goyim o afillu berov yisrael?

Ta shema: hammotze maot bevatte chenesiyyot uvevatte midrashot, uvechol makom sheharabbim metzuyin sham – hare ellu shello, mippene shehabbealim mityaashin mehen. man shamat leh deazel batar rubba? rabbi shimon ben elazar, shamat minna afillu berov yisrael name.
Hacha bemay askinan? bimfuzzarin. i bimfuzzarin may irya makom sheharabbim metzuyin sham? afillu en harabbim metzuyin sham!

Ella leolam bitzrurin, vehacha bemay askinan – bevatte chenesiyyot shel goyim, batte midrashot may ikka lememar? batte midrashot didan deyatvi behu goyim. hasheta deatet lehachi, batte chenesiyyot name didan deyatvi behu nachrim.

Ta shema: matza bah aveda, im rov yisrael – chayyayv lehacheriz, im rov goyim – eno chayyayv lehacheriz. man shamat leh deamar azlinan batar rubba? rabbi shimon ben elazar, shamat minna: ki kaamar rabbi shimon ben elazar berov goyim, aval berov yisrael – la!
Manni? rabbanan hi, tifshot minna demodu leh rabbanan lerabbi shimon ben elazar berov goyim.

Ella leolam rabbi shimon ben elazar hi, vaafillu berov yisrael name. vehacha bemay askinan? betamun. i betamun, may avidteh gabbeh?! vehatnan: matza keli baashpa, mechusse – lo yigga bo, megulle – notel umachriz.
Kidamar rav pappa, beashpa sheenah asuya lefannot, venimlach aleha lefannotah. hacha name beashpa sheenah asuya lefannot, venimlach aleha lefannotah.
b: Veibbaet ema: leolam rabbanan, mi katane "hen shello"? "eno chayyayv lehacheriz" katane. veyanniach, veyete yisrael veyahev beh simana veshakel.
Ta shema, deamar rav assi: matza chavit yayin beir sherubbah goyim – mutteret mishshum metzia vaasura bahanaa. ba yisrael venatan bah siman – mutteret bishtiyya, lemotzah.

Keman? kerabbi shimon ben elazar. shema minna ki kaamar rabbi shimon ben elazar – berov goyim aval berov yisrael la. leolam ema lach rabbi shimon ben elazar afillu berov yisrael name kaamar, verav assi savar la kevoteh bachada, ufelig aleh bachada.
Vechi meachar daasira bahanaa mutteret mishshum metzia, lemay hilcheta? amar rav ashe: lekankannah.

Hahu gavra deashkach arbaa zuze detzayyri bisdina ushedu binhar beran, ata lekammeh derav yehuda. amar leh: zil achrez. veha zoto shel yam hu! shane nehar beran, kevan demittekil la miyyaash. veha rubba goyim ninhu, shema minna en halacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar afillu berov goyim! shane nehar beran, deyisrael sachru leh veyisrael karu leh. kevan deyisrael sachru leh – emor miyyisrael nefal, vechevan deyisrael karu leh – la miyyaash.

Rav yehuda hava shakel veazel batreh demar shemuel beshuka deve daysa, amar leh: matza kan arnaki, mahu? amar leh: hare ellu shello. ba yisrael venatan bah siman, mahu? amar leh: chayyayv lehachezir. tarte! amar leh: lifnim mishshurat haddin. ki ha daavu dishmuel ashkach hanach chamare bemadbera veahderinhu lemarayyhu levatar teresar yarche shatta, lifnim mishshurat haddin.

Rava hava shakel veazel batreh derav nachman beshuka degildae, veamri la beshuka derabbanan, amar leh: matza kan arnaki, mahu? amar leh: hare ellu shello. ba yisrael venatan bah siman, mahu? amar leh: hare ellu shello. vahalo omed vetzoveach! naasa ketzoveach al beto shennafal veal sefinato shettava bayyam.

Hahu dayyo deshakel bisra beshuka veshadye betzinyayta deve bar mariyyon. ata lekammeh deabbaye, amar leh: zil shekol lenafshach. veha rubba deyisrael ninhu, shamat minna halacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar afillu berov yisrael! shane dayyo, dichzoto shel yam dame. veha amar rav: basar shennitallem min haayin – asur! beomed veroehu.

Rabbi chanina matza gedi shachut ben teverya letzippori vehittiruhu lo. amar rabbi amme: hittiruhu lo mishshum metzia kerabbi shimon ben elazar, mishshum shechita kerabbi chananya beno shel rabbi yose haggelili. detanya: hare sheavdu lo gedayav vetarnegolav, halach umetzaan shechutin, rabbi yehuda oser, verabbi chananya beno shel rabbi yose haggelili mattir.

Amar rabbi: nirin divre rabbi yehuda keshemmetzaan beashpa, vedivre rabbi chananya beno shel rabbi yose haggelili keshemmetzaan babbayit. middehittiruhu lo mishshum shechita, rubba yisrael ninhu, shamat minna halacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar afillu berov yisrael! amar rava: rov goyim verov tabbache yisrael.

Rabbi amme ashkach pargiyyot shechutot ben teverya letzippori, ata lekammeh derabbi assi, veamri la lekammeh derabbi yochanan, veamri la be midresha. vaamaru leh: zil shekol lenafshach. rabbi yitzchak nappacha ashkach kibbura deizle be azloye, ata lekammeh derabbi yochanan, veamri la beve midresha, vaamaru leh: zil shekol lenafshach.
Mishna veellu chayyayv lehacheriz: matza perot bichli, o keli kemot shehu. maot bechis, o kis kemot shehu. tzibbure ferot, tzibbure maot,
